name: Veer Kunwar Singh (वीर कुंवर सिंह)
popular_title: Babu, Veer Kunwar Singh, Lion of Bihar
qualifying_benchmark: Supreme Military Leader of 1857 Great Revolt in Bihar, Victorious over Captain Le Grand and Captain Dunbar

birth_and_roots.background_context: Babu Veer Kunwar Singh ka janam Jagdishpur ke Ujjainiya Parmar Rajput rajvansh mein hua tha. Raja Shahabzada Singh ke sabse bade suputra hone ke naate unhein riyasat ki zimmedari mili. Unhone kishoravastha se hi talwarbazi, ghudswari aur jungle warfare ki shiksha li. East India Company ki extractive land revenue policies aur Board of Revenue dwara Jagdishpur estate ko debt management ke naam par control karne ki koshishon ne unke aatmasamman ko chot pahunchayi. 80 saal ki vridhavastha mein bhi unka military zeal aur popular influence pure Shahabad mein Sarvochha tha, jisne unhein Bihar ke 1857 ke armed resistance ka supreme symbol banaya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: 1857 Revolt in Bihar, Capture of Arrah, Battles of Bibiganj, Atraulia, Azamgarh, Recapture of Jagdishpur
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: July 1857 mein Dinapur Cantonment ke mutinous sepoys ne Arrah aakar Kunwar Singh ko apna supreme commander ghoshit kiya. Unhone Arrah treasury aur administrative machinery ko capture kiya aur Captain Dunbar ki relief force ko ambushes ke zariye devastating defeat di. Arrah House relief ke baad unhone Central India aur Eastern UP (Mirzapur, Rewa, Banda, Lucknow, Kanpur) ka rukh kiya aur Nana Saheb aur Tatya Tope ke sath coordinate kiya. March 1858 mein Azamgarh mein British forces ko haraya. Shivpur Ghat par Ganga cross karte waqt British bullet lagne par unhone apna hath kaat kar Ganga mein samarpit kar diya. 23 April 1858 ko Captain Le Grand ki force ko Jagdishpur mein crush karke tiranga lehrane ke baad unki shahadat hui.

famous_works_or_edicts: Proclamations calling for joint Hindu-Muslim resistance against British East India Company
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Kunwar Singh ne British rule ke samantar ek decentralized military administrative system khada kiya jahan local kisanon, tribal units aur rebel sepoys ko ek sutra mein piroya gaya. Unke court ne communal harmony maintain ki aur civilian population par lootpat par kadi rok lagayi. Unki strategic guerrilla logistics aur Ganga river crossings modern military history mein guerrilla mobility ka classical chapter maani jaati hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: 80 varsh ki aayu mein asadharan sahas aur yuddh-koushal ke pradarshan ke karan aam janta aur itihas mein unhein 'Veer' aur '80 varshon ka Yuva' kaha gaya.
23 April 1858 ko Captain Le Grand ki British sena ko Jagdishpur ke paas dharashayi karna (jise har varsh Vijayotsav ke roop mein manaya jata hai).
Arrah mein 'Veer Kunwar Singh University' (VKSU) sthit hai; Bihar sarkar dwara 23 April ko rajkiya avkash aur Vijay Diwas ke roop mein celebrate kiya jata hai.
BPSC Prelims & Mains ka mandatory repeat topic: '1857 ke vidroh mein Bihar ka netritva kisne kiya tha? (Kunwar Singh)' tatha 'Jagdishpur mein vidroh ka ailan kab hua?'

name: Amar Singh (अमर सिंह)
popular_title: Babu Amar Singh, Kaimur ke Baaghi
qualifying_benchmark: Successor of Veer Kunwar Singh, Supreme Leader of Kaimur Guerrilla Resistance (1858–1859), Established Parallel Government

birth_and_roots.background_context: Babu Amar Singh Veer Kunwar Singh ke chhote bhai the. Ve Jagdishpur ke rajhansh ke paramparik yuddh abhyason aur jungle surveillance mein kafi efficient the. Apne bade bhai Kunwar Singh ke sath unhone shuruat se 1857 ke movement ki strategic planning mein barabar ka hissa liya. Shahabad aur Kaimur hills ke tribal aur rural geography par unka control tha. Kunwar Singh ke bahar rehne ke dauran Shahabad ke home front ki security aur logistical backup manage karne ki primary responsibility Amar Singh par thi.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Shahabad Parallel Government 1858, Kaimur Hills Guerrilla Warfare, Interception of Grand Trunk Road, Siege of Arrah Support
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: April 1858 mein Kunwar Singh ki mrityu ke baad Amar Singh ne vidroh ka netritva sambhala. Unhone Shahabad mein British rule ko completely displace karke ek parallel government chalayi jismein unke bhai Har Kishan Singh Commander-in-Chief bane. Unhone Kaimur ke ghaney janglon ko base banakar Brigadier Douglas aur Sir Edward Lugard ki forces ke khilaf protracted guerrilla resistance maintain kiya. Unhone Grand Trunk Road par British military convoys aur dak communications ko lambe samay tak block rakha. October 1858 mein jab British army ne massive encirclement shuru kiya tab ve Terai ki taraf shift hue. December 1859 mein Nepal Terai mein capture hone ke baad Gorakhpur Jail mein unki bimari ke chalte maut hui.

famous_works_or_edicts: Decrees issued for collection of land revenue by the Revolutionary Government of Shahabad
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Amar Singh ne yeh prove kiya ki Kunwar Singh ke jane ke baad bhi movement khatam nahi hua. Unki parallel government ne Shahabad ke collectorate, thanas aur kachehris ko lagbhag cheh mahine tak run kiya aur regular judicial orders issue kiye. Kaimur pahadiyon mein unke banaye cave hideouts aur military outposts British forces ke liye mahino tak impenetrable bane rahe.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Veer Kunwar Singh ke baad 1857 ki kranti ki dhar ko zinda rakhne ke karan unhein 'Shahabad Kranti ka Doosra Nayak' kaha gaya.
Kaimur ke janglon se 1858 ke aakhir tak British army ke multiple columns ko ambush karke paralyze karna.
Jagdishpur aur Arrah ke historical memorials mein Babu Amar Singh ki veerta par public commemorative structures sthit hain.
BPSC Prelims: 'Kunwar Singh ki mrityu ke baad 1857 ke vidroh ka netritva kisne sambhala tha? (Amar Singh)' tatha 'Kaimur pahadiyon mein kisne chhapamar yuddh chalaya?'

name: Pir Ali Khan (पीर अली ख़ान)
popular_title: Shaheed-e-Azam of Patna, 1857 Martyr
qualifying_benchmark: Spearheaded Patna Uprising of 3 July 1857, Assassinated Opium Agent Dr. Lyell, Publicly Hanged by British

birth_and_roots.background_context: Pir Ali Khan mool roop se Mohammadpur (Faizabad/Varanasi region) ke the, par unka lamba samay aur karmabhoomi Patna City ka Mohalla Gurhatta raha. Ve Patna City mein ek prasiddha pustak-vikreta (bookseller) the. Unki dukan sirf kitabon ki bikri ka sthal nahi thi, balki British shasan ke virodh mein chintan karne wale rashtravadiyon, faqeeron, aur Dinapur ke vidyarthi-sipahiyon ki secret meeting point ban gayi thi. Unpar colonial economic exploitation aur Company rule ke dharmik hastakshep ka tivra aakrosh tha, jisse unhone underground armed resistance cell develop kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Patna Armed Uprising of 3 July 1857, Assassination of Dr. Lyell, Secret Rebel Communication Network
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 3 July 1857 ko Pir Ali Khan ne Patna City mein lagbhag 200 sashastra krantikariyon ke sath khula vidroh kar diya. Unhone har-har mahadev aur allahu akbar ke naron ke sath Gulzarbagh aur local thanas par hamla kiya. Is clash ke dauran British Opium Agent Dr. R. Lyell ne vidroh ko dabane ki koshish ki, jise Pir Ali aur unke saathiyon ne goli maar kar dher kar diya. Patna Commissioner William Tayler ne massive Sikh battalion aur European troops bulakar vidroh ko brutally suppress kiya. 5 July ko Pir Ali ko unke ghar se arrest kiya gaya. Brutal torture ke bawajood unhone apne secret network ka ek bhi naam ugalne se inkar kar diya. 7 July 1857 ko unhein Patna mein aam janta ke samne phansi de di gayi.

famous_works_or_edicts: Famous Last Words: 'You can hang me today, but thousands of Pir Alis will rise to avenge my blood'
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Pir Ali Khan ne book-trade ko espionage aur anti-colonial pamphlets ke distribution ke liye use kiya. Unhone Dinapur ke sepoys aur civilian population ke beech communication gap ko bridge kiya. William Tayler ne apni autobiography 'Our Crisis' mein accept kiya ki Pir Ali ek fanatic aur uncompromising rebel the jinhone aakhri saans tak colonial state ke samne sar jhukane se inkar kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Patna mein 1857 ke pratham shashastra vidroh ka netritva karke balidan dene ke karan unhein 'Patna ka Amar Shaheed' mana jata hai.
3 July 1857 ko Patna uprising lead karna aur 7 July 1857 ko Commissioner William Tayler dwara public hanging.
Patna Gandhi Maidan ke samne unke samman mein 'Shaheed Pir Ali Khan Children's Park' sthit hai; state level par 7 July ko homage diya jata hai.
BPSC Prelims: 'Patna mein 1857 ke vidroh ki shuruat 3 July 1857 ko kisne ki thi? (Pir Ali Khan)' tatha 'Dr. Lyell ki hatya kis vidroh mein hui thi?'

name: Hare Krishna Singh (हरे कृष्ण सिंह)
popular_title: Commander-in-Chief of Shahabad Forces
qualifying_benchmark: Commander-in-Chief of Kunwar Singh's Revolutionary Army, Mastermind of Arrah Ambush, Publicly Executed in 1859

birth_and_roots.background_context: Babu Hare Krishna Singh Barigaon ke ek prathisthit aur yuddh-koushal mein nipun zamindar parivar se aate the. Unka parivar Jagdishpur ke Ujjainiya rajvansh se ghanishtha roop se juda tha. Unhone traditional guerrilla warfare, military artillery coordination aur army troop positioning ki master training li thi. 1857 ke dauran jab Dinapur ke sipahiyon ne vidroh kiya, Hare Krishna Singh ne Kunwar Singh ke pradhan sainik salahkar aur field marshal ke roop mein control sambhala.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Command of Shahabad Rebel Army, Siege of Arrah House, Defeat of Captain Dunbar, Battle of Azamgarh
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Hare Krishna Singh ne July 1857 mein Arrah House ki gherabandi ko professionally design kiya. 29-30 July 1857 ko unhone Captain Dunbar ki 400 British soldiers ki force ko Bibiganj ke ghaney bageeche mein night ambush mein trap kiya, jismein Dunbar samet lagbhag 300 British troops mare gaye. Kunwar Singh ke Central India campaign ke dauran ve army ke har movement aur retreat coordination ke commander the. Kunwar Singh ke baad Amar Singh ke shasan mein ve Shahabad Revolutionary Government ke Commander-in-Chief appoint hue. 1859 ke aakhir mein betrayal ke chalte arrest hone ke baad Jagdishpur mein unhein British troops dwara phansi di gayi.

institutions_or_initiatives: Chief of Military Staff, Kunwar Singh's Revolutionary Forces (1857–1858)
famous_works_or_edicts: Operational Battle Orders of Shahabad Armed Columns
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Hare Krishna Singh Kunwar Singh ki sena ke tactical brain the. Dunbar ke slaughter se lekar Azamgarh ke tactical retreat tak unki military planning active thi. Unhone Dinapur ke sepoys aur local Bhojpuri lathayiton ko ek disciplined combat force mein dhalne ka institutional role nibhaya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Kunwar Singh sena ke sarvochha military commander hone ke karan unhein 'Krantikari Senapati' ka status mila.
July 1857 mein Captain Dunbar ki British relief force ko Arrah ke bageeche mein annihilate karna.
Jagdishpur aur Bhojpur ke 1857 war memorials mein Hare Krishna Singh ki martyrdom shilalekhon par engraved hai.
BPSC Mains & Prelims: 'Babu Kunwar Singh ke pradhan senapati kaun the jinhone Arrah par hamle ki yojana banayi thi? (Hare Krishna Singh)'.

name: Nishan Singh (निशान सिंह)
popular_title: Martyr of the Cannon, Top General of Kunwar Singh
qualifying_benchmark: Supreme Battlefield General of 1857 in South Bihar, Blown from a Cannon (Top se Udaya Gaya) at Sasaram on 7 June 1858

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Budhari village, Rohtas district (erstwhile Shahabad), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Babu Nishan Singh Rohtas ke Budhari gaon ke ek prabhavshali Rajput parivar se the. Ve shuruat se physical strength, swadeshi aatmasamman aur nidar vyaktitva ke liye jaane jaate the. Sasaram aur Rohtas ke kisanon aur feudal chiefs ke beech unka gehra sambandh tha. Jab 1857 ka vidroh Dinapur aur Arrah mein shuru hua, Nishan Singh ne apne gaon aur aas-paas ke ilakon se saikdon yoddhaon ko lekar Kunwar Singh ke camp mein join kiya aur unke core leadership group ke military general bane.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Battle of Arrah, Defense of Jagdishpur Fort, Campaigns in Rewa and Banda, Battle of Atraulia
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Nishan Singh ne Kunwar Singh ke har bade military campaign mein frontline combat handle kiya. July 1857 se lekar May 1858 tak ve Kunwar Singh ke sath rahe. Atraulia aur Azamgarh ki ladaiyon mein unhone British cavalry aur artillery ke khilaf swordsmanship aur cavalry counter-attacks lead kiye. May 1858 mein jab Captain Le Grand ki sena ne Jagdishpur par hamla kiya, Nishan Singh un commanders mein the jinhone Le Grand ki regiment ko complete wipe out kiya. Kunwar Singh ke dehavasan ke baad ve Sasaram kshetra mein organization ke liye gaye jahan ek local informer ke betrayal par Britishers ne unhein arrest kiya. 7 June 1858 ko Sasaram mein unhein top (cannon) ke muh par baandhkar publically udha diya gaya.

institutions_or_initiatives: Council of War of Kunwar Singh
famous_works_or_edicts: Interrogation Deposition before British Magistrates (Heroic Statement of Defiance)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Nishan Singh ka British magistrate ke samne diya gaya statement 1857 ke history ka landmark document hai jismein unhone bina darr ke admit kiya ki unhone British rule ko jad se ukhadne ke liye Arrah se lekar Azamgarh tak yuddh lada tha aur unhein apne kiye par garv hai. Unki brutal execution ne Shahabad mein aakrosh ko double kar diya tha.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Sasaram mein top ke ghole se shaheed hone ke karan unhein 'Top ke Shaheed' aur 'Veer Nishan Singh' kaha gaya.
7 June 1858 ko Sasaram mein British army dwara unhein canon ke muh par baandhkar execute kiya jana.
Sasaram (Rohtas) mein Nishan Singh Smriti Park aur unka shahadat sthal state protected site hai.
BPSC Prelims: '1857 ke vidroh mein Kunwar Singh ke kis sahayogi ko Sasaram mein top se baandhkar uda diya gaya tha? (Nishan Singh)'.

name: Judhar Singh (जोधर सिंह)
popular_title: Liberator of Arwal and Jehanabad (1857)
qualifying_benchmark: Commander of 1857 Armed Insurgency in Arwal and Jehanabad, Cut off British Communication on GT Road

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Khamini village, Arwal district (erstwhile Gaya/Jehanabad), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Babu Judhar Singh Arwal ke Khamini gaon ke ek bahadur zamindar kisan parivar se aate the. Magadh belt mein British company ke thikadaron dwara kisanon ke shoshan aur oppressive police stations ke chalte unke andar virodh ki aag thi. Jab Kunwar Singh ne Shahabad mein tiranga uthaya, Judhar Singh ne Son nadi paar karke Kunwar Singh se contact banaya aur Magadh region (Arwal, Jehanabad aur Gaya) mein 1857 movement ka charge liya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Capture of Arwal and Jehanabad Thanas, Disruption of Grand Trunk Road, Liberation of Daudnagar
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: August 1857 mein Judhar Singh ne lagbhag 1,000 hathiyarband kisanon aur rebel sepoys ke sath Arwal aur Jehanabad thanas par hamla kiya aur British officers ko bhagane par majboor kar diya. Unhone Daudnagar aur Aurangabad belt mein British indigo factories aur government kachehris ko demolish kar diya. Grand Trunk (GT) Road par British postal aur ammunition convoys par lagatar chhapamar attacks karke unhone Patna aur Calcutta ke beech communication ko thapp kar diya. Captain Rattray ki Sikh Police Battalion ne unpar multiple assaults kiye, par Judhar Singh ne forested corridors mein saalon tak resistance zinda rakha.

famous_works_or_edicts: Decree declaring Son River basin free from British police interference (1857)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Judhar Singh ne 1857 ke vidroh ko Shahabad se nikaalkar Magadh aur Gaya district tak expand kiya. Unhone dikhaya ki local landlord aur tenant milkari British garrisons ko isolated kar sakte hain. Unke forces ke chalte British administration ko Magadh mein martial law maintain karna pada tha.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Arwal aur Jehanabad ke kisanon ke beech unhein 'Magadh ka Kranti Nayak' ke roop mein aadar mila.
August-September 1857 mein Grand Trunk Road ki security ko dismantle karke British supplies capture karna.
Arwal aur Jehanabad historical records mein unki role ko official state records mein recognize kiya gaya hai.
BPSC State GK: '1857 ke vidroh ke dauran Arwal aur Jehanabad ke kshetron mein vidroh ka netritva kisne kiya tha? (Judhar Singh)'.

name: Waris Ali / Julfan Ali (वारिस अली)
popular_title: Martyr Police Jamadar of Tirhut (1857)
qualifying_benchmark: Intercepted Carrying Seditious Correspondence from Delhi Rebel Court, Hanged at Muzaffarpur in July 1857

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Delhi / Linked to Royal Mughal Lineage (Stationed in Tirhut/Muzaffarpur), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Waris Ali British government ke police department mein Tirhut division (Muzaffarpur) ke Barkagaon thana mein Jamadar (Police Officer) ke roop mein posted the. Unka family background Delhi ke imperial Mughal court se related tha. Unhone sarkari naukri mein rehte hue bhi Bahadur Shah Zafar ke darbar aur Bihar ke revolutionary underground network ke sath direct secret contact banaya hua tha. Unka maksad North Bihar ki military units ko rebel karwake Tirhut division ko British control se azaad karwana tha.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Sedition in Tirhut Police Ranks, Espionage for Mughal Court, Armed Coup Planning in Muzaffarpur
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: June 1857 mein Waris Ali ne Muzaffarpur aur Tirhut ke policemen aur civilian groups ko aane wale armed revolt ke liye prepare kiya. 23 June 1857 ko Major Holmes aur Magistrate ne suspicion ke aadhar par unhein intercept kiya. Unke paas se highly confidential seditious letters pakde gaye jo Delhi ke rebel leaders aur Ali Karim (Patna ke rebel leader) ko address kiye gaye the, jismein Bihar mein ek sath armed rebellion trigger karne ka masterplan tha. Unhein turant arrest karke Muzaffarpur laya gaya. Summary military trial ke baad July 1857 mein unhein publically phansi par latka diya gaya. Marne se pehle unhone naara lagaya ki agar koi unka badla lega toh ve khushi se mar rahe hain.

famous_works_or_edicts: Intercepted Revolutionary Letters to Ali Karim and Delhi Court (Historic Evidence)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Waris Ali ka case yeh prove karta hai ki colonial police ke Indian officers andar se kitne anti-British the. Unki execution ke baad Tirhut division ke magistrate ne report bheji ki agar Waris Ali kuch din aur arrest na hote toh poora North Bihar company ke hath se nikal chuka hota.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: North Bihar mein 1857 ke pratham phansi pane wale police martyr ke roop mein darj.
June 1857 mein Barkagaon thana se arrest hona aur July 1857 mein Muzaffarpur mein execution.
Muzaffarpur district gazetteer aur Bihar State Archives mein unke case documents display par hain.
BPSC Prelims: '1857 ke vidroh ke dauran Tirhut mein kis police Jamadar ko baghavat ke aarop mein phansi di gayi thi? (Waris Ali)'.

name: Maulana Inayat Ali (मौलाना इनायत अली)
popular_title: Field Leader of the Patna Wahabi Movement
qualifying_benchmark: Joint Supreme Leader of Wahabi Movement in Bihar, Commander of the Frontier Holy War (Jihad) against British Raj

birth_and_roots.background_context: Maulana Inayat Ali ka janam Patna City ke Sadiqpur ke ek vidwan aur prabhavshali Syed parivar mein hua tha. Ve Maulana Wilayat Ali ke chhote bhai the. Dono bhaiyon ne Shah Waliullah ke puritanical reforms aur Syed Ahmad Barelvi ke anti-colonial resistance ko apnaya. Sadiqpur us daur mein poore sub-continent ka sabse organized underground revolutionary center tha jahan se British rule ko ukhadne ke liye funds, arms aur trained recruits North-West Frontier (Sittana) bheje jaate the.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Frontier Armed Resistance at Sittana, Underground Financial Network of Patna, Mass Anti-British Mobilization
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Maulana Inayat Ali ne 1830s se 1850s ke dauran North-West Frontier Province (NWFP) ke Sittana aur Swat regions mein British forces ke khilaf multiple armed battles lead kiye. Unhone Patna ke Sadiqpur se lekar Peshawar tak clandestine courier system khada kiya jisse dhan aur mujahideen circulate hote the. 1857 ke vidroh ke theek pehle unhone frontier par British posts par violent strikes conduct karwaye jisse British army ko do-front war ladna pada. Unki tireless organization ne Wahabi movement ko pure Bharat ka sabse well-organized underground resistance movement banaya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Treatises on Anti-Imperialist Struggle and Financial Support (Risalas)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Maulana Inayat Ali ka historical yogdan pan-Indian resistance network build karne mein tha. Unhone Patna ko resistance ka capital banaya jahan se lakho rupaye secretively frontier bheje jaate the. British administration ne Sadiqpur par raid maarkar unke centers ko demolish kiya aur unki leadership ko colonial rule ke liye sabse khatarnak internal threat maana.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: British intelligence records mein unhein 'The Most Dangerous Rebel Organizer of Sadiqpur' ke roop mein categorize kiya gaya tha.
1840s-50s mein Sittana frontier camp par direct military operations command karna.
Patna City ke Sadiqpur mein unke historical legacy sites hain; Khuda Bakhsh Library mein unke documents preserved hain.
BPSC Prelims: '19th century mein Patna kis mukhya krantikari/dharmik andolan ka kendra tha? (Wahabi Movement - Inayat Ali aur Wilayat Ali)'.

name: Maulana Wilayat Ali (मौलाना विलायत अली)
popular_title: Supreme Ideologue of Patna Wahabi Movement
qualifying_benchmark: Supreme Head of the Wahabi Centre at Patna, Directed Subcontinental Resistance against British Raj

birth_and_roots.background_context: Maulana Wilayat Ali Sadiqpur (Patna) ke sabse senior religious scholar aur thinker the. Unhone Arabic, Persian aur Islamic jurisprudence mein unch-koti ki shiksha li. Syed Ahmad Barelvi ke mukhya Khalifa aur successor hone ke naate unhone Patna ko pure movement ka permanent central nerve-center banaya. Unka vision tha ki British rule Bharat ki sovereignty aur sanskriti ko destroy kar raha hai, isliye physical, ideological aur financial resources ko foreign rule ke khilaf mobilize karna farz hai.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Central Command of Wahabi Movement, Organization of Southern & Eastern India Cells, Battle of Balakot Continuity
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1831 ke Balakot yuddh ke baad jab Syed Ahmad shaheed hue, tab Wilayat Ali ne movement ko collapse hone se bachaya aur central leadership sambhali. Unhone Bengal, Bihar, UP aur Hyderabad tak personal tours karke underground branches sthapit ki. Unhone Patna ke Sadiqpur mansion ko ek administrative headquarters banaya jahan tax collection, recruitment aur secret printing press chalte the. British government ne unhein multiple times arrest kiya aur unpar sedition acts lagaye, par unhone court ke aage jhukne se inkar kiya aur Sittana camp par continuous reinforcement dispatch karte rahe.

famous_works_or_edicts: Amal-bil-Hadees Treatises
Ideological Letters on Non-Cooperation with British Courts
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Maulana Wilayat Ali ne 19th century mein non-cooperation aur tax boycott ka model implement kiya tha jo baad mein national movement mein mainstream bana. Unhone parallel judicial system run kiya jahan aam log British courts ke bajaye local courts mein jate the. Unke family ke balidan ke chalte Britishers ne baad mein Ambala aur Patna Trials (1860s) chalaye aur Sadiqpur ke gharon ko bulldoz karwaya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Wahabi movement ke supreme intellectual guide hone ke karan unhein 'Ameer-ul-Hind' ke roop mein respect mila.
1830s-1850s mein Patna ko all-India underground anti-colonial network ka headquarters bana kar operate karna.
Khuda Bakhsh Oriental Public Library Patna mein Wilayat Ali aur Inayat Ali ke manuscripts preserved hain.
BPSC History: 'Patna ke Wahabi andolan ke mukhya netritvakarta kaun the? (Maulana Wilayat Ali aur Inayat Ali)'.

name: Pandit Raj Kumar Shukla (पंडित राजकुमार शुक्ल)
popular_title: Catalyst of Champaran Satyagraha, Kisan Neta
qualifying_benchmark: Primary Catalyst who Brought Mahatma Gandhi to Champaran (1917), Ended Tinkathia System

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Murli Bharhawa village, West Champaran district, Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Pandit Raj Kumar Shukla West Champaran ke Murli Bharhawa gaon ke ek aam kisan parivar mein janme the. Ve self-respecting kisan the jinki zameen par British indigo planters (neelaha saheb) ne jabardasti Tinkathia system thopa hua tha. Indigo planters ke brutal physical torture, illegal fine (Sharahkan aur Tawan) aur police nexus ne unke ghar ko auction karwaya aur unki faslein loot lin. In personal aur collective atrocities ne unhein ek indomitable kisan leader banaya jinhone national level tak aawaz uthane ka faisla kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Champaran Satyagraha 1917, Persuasion of Gandhi at Lucknow INC (1916), Abolition of Tinkathia Pratha
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: December 1916 ke Lucknow Congress session mein Shukla ji ne Brajkishore Prasad ke sath milkar Champaran ke kisanon ki pida ka resolution rakhwaya. Wahan unki mulakat Mahatma Gandhi se hui. Jab Gandhi ji ne busy schedule bataya, Shukla ji ne unka peecha nahi chhoda—ve Lucknow se Kanpur, Sabarmati Ashram (Ahmedabad), aur Calcutta tak unke sath gaye. Unki resolute persistence ko dekhkar Gandhi ji impress hue aur April 1917 mein Patna pahuche jahan se Shukla ji unhein Champaran le gaye. Gandhi ji ke sath ghoom-ghoom kar unhone hazaron kisanon ke raw statements record karwaye, jiske chalte Champaran Agrarian Committee bani aur Tinkathia system abolish hua.

famous_works_or_edicts: Personal Diary of Raj Kumar Shukla (Firsthand historical record of Gandhi's arrival)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Shukla ji ki niji diary modern Indian history ka ek pristine archival document hai jo 1914 se 1919 tak ke Champaran kisan sangharsh aur Gandhi ji ki movements ko day-by-day record karti hai. Gandhi ji ne apni 'My Experiments with Truth' (Atmakatha) mein Shukla ji ke persistence aur simple honesty ko homage diya hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Champaran mein Gandhi ji ke pravesh ke mukhya sutradhar hone ke karan unhein 'Champaran ka Agadoot' kaha gaya.
December 1916 ke Lucknow Congress adhiveshan mein Gandhi ji ko Champaran aane ke liye raazi karna.
Bharat sarkar dwara unki smriti mein commemorative postage stamp jari kiya gaya; West Champaran mein unke gaon mein smarak sthit hai.
BPSC Prelims ka classic question: 'Gandhi ji ko Champaran aane ka nimantran kisne diya tha? (Raj Kumar Shukla)' tatha 'Shukla ji ka janm gaon kaun sa tha? (Murli Bharhawa)'.

name: Brajkishore Prasad (ब्रजकिशोर प्रसाद)
popular_title: Babu Brajkishore, Stambha of Champaran Movement
qualifying_benchmark: Introduced Historic Champaran Resolution at Lucknow Congress (1916), Gandhi's Chief Investigative Counsel in 1917

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Srinagar village, Siwan district (Karmabhoomi: Darbhanga & Patna), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Babu Brajkishore Prasad ka janam Siwan ke Srinagar gaon ke ek prathisthit Kayastha parivar mein hua tha. Patna College aur Calcutta se Law complete karne ke baad unhone Darbhanga Bar mein apni practice shuru ki aur jaldi hi North Bihar ke sabse unche legal luminaries mein gine jane lage. Ve Dr. Rajendra Prasad ke mentor aur Prabhavati Devi (JP ki patni) ke pita the. Unka man legal wealth accumulation mein nahi balki kisanon ki service aur Swadeshi education mein laga raha.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Champaran Agrarian Inquiries 1917, Drafting of Legislative Bills in Bengal/Bihar Council, Non-Cooperation Movement
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1915-16 mein Bihar Legislative Council ke member ke roop mein unhone British planters ke zulm par rigorous debates generate kiye. 1916 ke Lucknow Congress session mein unhone hi historic resolution officially move kiya jismein Champaran ke ryots par inquiry ki demand thi. Jab Gandhi ji April 1917 mein Champaran pahuche, Brajkishore Babu ne apni full-time practice chhodkar inquiry team ka legal brain sambhala. Unhone indigo planters ke contract documents ke legal loopholes ko expose kiya. 1920 ke Asahyog Andolan ke aavhan par unhone Council aur legal practice ko permanently tyag diya.

institutions_or_initiatives: Member, Bihar and Orissa Legislative Council
Founder Patron, National Schools in North Bihar
famous_works_or_edicts: Speeches in the Legislative Council on Tenancy Legislation and Planters' Oppression
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Brajkishore Prasad ne Gandhi ji ko Bihar ke local political aur legal realities se familiar karwaya. Unki sadagi aur dedication ko dekhkar Gandhi ji unpar atoot vishwas karte the. Unhone Rajendra Prasad, Anugrah Narayan Sinha aur Shrikrishna Sinha jaise yuvaon ko freedom movement ke liye inspire karke dedicated leadership bench taiyar ki.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Mahatma Gandhi ne unki selfless service aur wisdom ko dekhkar unhein 'The Soul of Bihar' kaha tha.
1916 ke Lucknow Congress adhiveshan mein Champaran kisan grievance resolution ko formally place karna.
Siwan aur Darbhanga mein Brajkishore Memorial institutions sthit hain; Bihar state archives mein unke speeches preserved hain.
BPSC Prelims & Mains: 'Champaran Satyagraha ke dauran Gandhi ji ke sabse senior vakeel sahayogi kaun the? (Brajkishore Prasad)'.

name: Pir Mohammad Munis (पीर मोहम्मद मूनिस)
popular_title: Dukhi Hridaya, Pioneer of Fearless Rural Journalism
qualifying_benchmark: Exposed European Planter Atrocities in Pratap (Kanpur), Architect of Champaran Intellectual Awakening, Imprisoned for Sedition

birth_and_roots.background_context: Pir Mohammad Munis ka janam Bettiah ke ek sadharan Muslim parivar mein hua tha. Padhai ke baad unhone Bettiah Guru Training School mein teacher ke roop mein kaam shuru kiya. Bettiah ke gaon-gaon mein indigo planters (neelaha saheb) dwara kisanon par kiye jane wale physical lashings, auraton ke apman aur illegal tax imposition ko unhone apni ankhon se dekha. Unhone teacher ki secure naukri ki parwah na karte hue apni lekhani ko British planters ke khilaf top bana diya. Unpar Ganesh Shankar Vidyarthi ki revolutionary journalism ka gehra asar tha.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Investigative Journalism against Indigo Planters, Preparation of Ground for Champaran Satyagraha 1917, Sedition Trial
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Munis ji ne Ganesh Shankar Vidyarthi ke Kanpur se nikalne wale newspaper 'Pratap' mein 'Dukhi Hridaya', 'Dukhi', aur 'Champaran ki Praja' ke naam se anonymous dhardaar reports likhin. In articles ne Champaran ke brutal reality ko national headlines bana diya. Unhone Raj Kumar Shukla ko guide kiya ki kaise national leadership ka dhyan Champaran par laya jaye. 1917 mein jab Gandhi ji Bettiah pahuche, Munis unke sath rahe. British police ne unhein 'dangerous seditionist' declare karke unki teacher job se terminate karwaya aur unhein physically beat karke jail mein daala.

famous_works_or_edicts: Iconic Investigative Articles: 'Champaran Mein Andher' and 'Champaran Ki Durdasha' in Pratap
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Pir Mohammad Munis modern Hindi investigative journalism ke pioneer hain. Unhone sabse pehle British bureaucracy aur European planters ke unholy nexus ko public domain mein expose kiya. Police reports mein unhein 'the chief brain behind Shukla and the agrarian agitation' ke roop mein document kiya gaya tha.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Pratap akhbar mein kisanon ke dukh par likhte waqt unhone 'Dukhi Hridaya' aur 'Dukhi' upnaam se national recognition paayi.
1915-16 mein Pratap mein articles likh kar Champaran issue ko national issue banana aur 1918 mein sedition arrest.
Bettiah mein unke samman mein smriti karyakram aayojit hote hain; modern journalism research mein unka role padhaya jata hai.
BPSC History & Press: 'Champaran ke kisanon ki pida ko Kanpur ke 'Pratap' akhbar mein 'Dukhi Hridaya' upnaam se kisne likha tha? (Pir Mohammad Munis)'.

name: Batakh Mian (बतख मियाँ)
popular_title: Deshrathna Savior, Unsung Hero of Champaran 1917
qualifying_benchmark: Foiled British Planter Erwin's Plot to Poison Mahatma Gandhi (Champaran 1917), Sacrificed House and Property to State Terror

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Siswaniya village, Motihari, East Champaran district, Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Batakh Mian ka janam Motihari ke Siswaniya gaon ke ek atyant garib kisan Muslim parivar mein hua tha. Rozi-roti ke liye ve Motihari ke British Indigo Planter Manager Erwin ke aawash par rasoiye (cook) ke roop mein kaam karte the. Siswaniya gaon indigo exploitation ka shikar tha. Batakh Mian ne dekha tha ki kaise British factory owners aam kisanon par lathiyan barsate the. Unke andar aam kisan ke liye empathy aur desh-prem tha, jiska test unki life ke sabse critical moment par hua.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Saving Mahatma Gandhi's Life (1917), Resistance against British Planter Coercion, Endurance of Extreme State Retribution
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1917 ke Champaran Satyagraha ke dauran European Planter Manager Erwin ne Mahatma Gandhi ko dinner par bulaya. Erwin ne Batakh Mian ko dhamki aur rishwat di ki ve Gandhi ji ko diye jane wale doodh ke glass mein zehar (poison) mila dein. Batakh Mian ne doodh ka glass plate mein rakha, par jaise hi Gandhi ji glass uthane lage, Batakh Mian ne rote hue unka hath pakad liya aur sach ugal diya ki doodh mein zehar mila hua hai. Is act ne Gandhi ji ki jaan bachayi. Iske baad British administration ne unpar inhuman torture kiya, unka chhota sa ghar bulldoze kar diya, zameen neelam kar di aur unhein saalon tak jail mein rakha.

famous_works_or_edicts: Eyewitness Testimony exposing Erwin's Poison Plot
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Batakh Mian ka balidan Indian national struggle ke sabse pure personal sacrifices mein se ek hai. Unhone apni aur apne parivar ki sari zameen, ghar aur aazaadi kho di sirf isliye taaki desh ke neta Mahatma Gandhi ki jaan bachayi ja sake. 1950 mein jab President Dr. Rajendra Prasad Motihari gaye, unhone bheed mein se Batakh Mian ko pehchana aur unke samman mein zameen allot karne ka presidential order pass karwaya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: 1917 mein Mahatma Gandhi ko vish-pan se bachane ke karan unhein 'Bapu ka Pran-Rakshak' kaha gaya.
1917 mein British planter Erwin ke zehar diye hue doodh ke glass ko phek kar Gandhi ji ki jaan bachana.
Motihari mein Batakh Mian Smarak sthit hai; unke parivar ko rashtriya dharohar ke roop mein recognition di gayi.
BPSC Prelims & Special Events: '1917 ke Champaran daure ke dauran Mahatma Gandhi ko zehar dekar maarne ki saazish ko kisne be-naqaab kiya tha? (Batakh Mian)'.

name: Gorakh Prasad (गोरख प्रसाद)
popular_title: Host of Satyagraha, Pillar of Motihari Legal Defense
qualifying_benchmark: Host of Mahatma Gandhi in Motihari (1917), Key Investigator in Recording Peasant Testimonies

birth_and_roots.background_context: Gorakh Prasad Motihari ke ek highly respected aur prosperous advocate the. Unka parivar nationalist vicharon se juda tha. Us daur mein jab British collectors aur European planters ke khauf se aam log Gandhi ji ko apne ghar mein thehrane se darte the, Gorakh Prasad ne bina dare apna pura ghar aur premises Gandhi ji aur unki team ke disposal par rakh diya. Unka ghar Champaran Satyagraha ka pehla formal control room bana.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Headquarters of Champaran Satyagraha, Legal Scrutiny of Ryots' Statements, Non-Cooperation Movement
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 15 April 1917 ko jab Gandhi ji Motihari pahuche, Gorakh Prasad ke aawash par unka reception hua. Agle do mahinon tak Gorakh Prasad ka ghar hazaron kisanon ka meeting center bana raha jahan Gandhi ji, Rajendra Prasad aur J.B. Kripalani ne thousands of peasant statements document kiye. British police aur magistrate ne Gorakh Prasad par continuous pressure banaya aur threats diye par ve unshakeable rahe. 1920 ke Asahyog Andolan ke dauran unhone apni practice restrict ki aur local nationalist schools organize karne mein funding provide ki.

institutions_or_initiatives: Motihari Satyagraha Headquarters (Residence of Gorakh Prasad, 1917)
famous_works_or_edicts: Documentation Records of Champaran Peasant Deposition Summaries
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Gorakh Prasad ka role resistance logistics mein tha. Unhone local administration ke notice aur summon orders ka continuous legal reply taiyar kiya. Unka residence 'Gorakh Prasad ki Kothi' Indian modern history ka historic milestone hai jahan Bharat ke pehle successful Satyagraha ki daily operational strategy execute hui thi.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Motihari mein Gandhi ji ke sabse vishwas-patra host aur kanooni sahayak ke roop mein sammanit.
April 1917 mein apne ghar ko Satyagraha ka central office banana jahan Gandhi ji ka headquarters chala.
Motihari mein unke aawash ko historical tourism circuit mein include kiya gaya hai.
BPSC Champaran Studies: 'April 1917 mein Motihari pahunchne par Mahatma Gandhi kis prasiddha vakeel ke aawash par thehre the? (Gorakh Prasad)'.

name: Babu Dharnidhar Prasad (बाबू धरणीधर प्रसाद)
popular_title: Selfless Satyagrahi of Mithila
qualifying_benchmark: Pioneer Legal Investigator in Champaran Satyagraha (1917), Abandoned Lucrative Practice on Gandhi's Call

birth_and_roots.background_context: Babu Dharnidhar Prasad Mithilanchal ke ek vidwan aur unch-koti ke Kayastha parivar mein janme the. Unhone Calcutta aur Patna se Law complete kiya aur Darbhanga mein practice shuru ki jahan unka reputation ek brilliant legal mind aur saintly character ke roop mein tha. Brajkishore Prasad ke close friend the. 1917 mein jab Gandhi ji ka aavhan hua, unhone bina ek pal soche apni thriving legal practice lock kar di aur Champaran ke dehati ilakon mein kisanon ke statements record karne nikal pade.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Champaran Peasant Inquiries 1917, Cross-Examination of Indigo Planter Evidences, Non-Cooperation Mobilization
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Dharnidhar Prasad ne Ramnavmi Prasad aur Rajendra Prasad ke sath milkar Champaran ke ghaney dehati kshetron (Bettiah, Shikarpur, Madhuban) mein jakar kisanon ke cross-examinations kiye. Unhone European planters ke contracts ke fraud aur illegal collection proofs compile kiye. Jab British government ne Gandhi ji ko arrest karne ka try kiya, Dharnidhar Babu un shuruati vakeelon mein the jinhone pratigya li ki agar Gandhi ji jail jayenge toh saare vakeel bhi unke piche jail jayenge. Is commitment ne pure movement ko invincible bana diya. 1920 mein unhone permanent public life choose ki.

famous_works_or_edicts: Legal Analysis of Planters' Contracts and Sharahkan Impositions
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Dharnidhar Prasad un leaders mein the jinhone showmanship ke bajaye silent field work ko importance di. Unke accurate statement recordings ke chalte Champaran Agrarian Committee ke samne British planters ek bhi jhooth establish nahi kar sake. Unka jeevan Gandhian sadagi aur nispaksh honesty ka embodiment tha.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Gandhi ji ke core inquiry team ke sabse selfless aur shant yoddha ke roop mein sammanit.
1917 mein Gandhi ji ke arrest ke threat par legal fraternity dwara court courting arrest lene ka resolution pass karna.
Champaran Satyagraha centenary records mein unka contribution golden letters mein documented hai.
BPSC Prelims: 'Champaran Satyagraha 1917 mein Gandhi ji ke sath inquiry team mein shamil hone wale Mithila ke pramukh neta kaun the? (Dharnidhar Prasad)'.

name: Maulana Mazharul Haque (मौलाना मज़रूल हक़)
popular_title: Deshbhakt Faqeer (देशभक्त फ़क़ीर), Grand Old Man of Bihar
qualifying_benchmark: Donated Private Land for Sadaqat Ashram (1921), Founded Historic Nationalist Newspaper 'The Motherland', Pioneer of Non-Cooperation in Bihar

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Bahpura village, Bihta, Patna district (Karmabhoomi: Sadaqat Ashram, Patna & Siwan), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Maulana Mazharul Haque ka janam Patna ke Bahpura gaon ke ek dhani zamindar parivar mein hua tha. Patna College aur Canning College Lucknow se padhai ke baad unhone London jakar Inner Temple se Bar-at-Law complete kiya. London mein unki mulakat Mahatma Gandhi aur Ali Imam se hui aur unhone 'Anjuman Islamia' banayi. Wapas aakar unhone Chapra aur Patna mein legal practice shuru ki. Luxurious life jeene wale Haque saheb ne Gandhi ji ke sampark mein aakar sab kuch tyag diya aur khadi pahan kar faqeer ka jeevan apnaya. Unka political philosophy secularism aur composite nationalism par aadharit tha.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Foundation of Sadaqat Ashram (1921), Bihar Vidyapeeth Chancellor, The Motherland Newspaper, Non-Cooperation & Khilafat
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1920 ke Asahyog Andolan ke dauran unhone Patna-Digha road par apni 16 bigha private land daan kar di jahan unhone 'Sadaqat Ashram' (Abode of Truth) ki neev rakhi, jo aage chalkar Bihar ke freedom struggle ka permanent temple bana. Wahan unhone 'Bihar Vidyapeeth' setup kiya aur uske Chancellor bane. September 1921 mein unhone Sadaqat Ashram se English weekly 'The Motherland' shuru kiya jismein unhone colonial administration aur police repression par fearless articles likhe, jiske chalte unhein arrest kiya gaya aur fine lagaya gaya. Unhone Hindu-Muslim unity ke liye ajeevan kaam kiya aur aakhri din Siwan ke 'Ashiana' aawash par sadagi mein bitaye.

famous_works_or_edicts: Editorials of The Motherland on Sedition, Swaraj, and Communal Amity
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Maulana Mazharul Haque Bihar mein national institutional building ke master architect the. 1916 mein jab Bihar mein Home Rule League bani, unhein uska President chuna gaya tha. Unka newspaper 'The Motherland' pure desh mein fearless journalism ka standard bana. Sadaqat Ashram ne Dr. Rajendra Prasad aur hazaron freedom fighters ko home aur leadership headquarters provide kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Khadar pehen kar sadagi apnane aur saari sampatti rashtra ko daan karne ke karan Mahatma Gandhi ne unhein 'Deshbhakt Faqeer' kaha.
1921 mein Sadaqat Ashram ki sthapna aur rashtravadi samachar patra 'The Motherland' ka publication.
Patna mein 'Maulana Mazharul Haque Arabic and Persian University' sthit hai; Sadaqat Ashram unki permanent dharohar hai.

BPSC Prelims: 'Patna mein Sadaqat Ashram aur Bihar Vidyapeeth ki sthapna kisne ki thi?', 'The Motherland samachar patra kisne shuru kiya?' tatha '1916 mein Bihar Home Rule League ke adhyaksh kaun the?'

name: Ambika Kant Sinha (अंबिका कांत सिन्हा)
popular_title: Hero of Nakhas Pind Salt Satyagraha
qualifying_benchmark: Commander of Historic Nakhas Pind Salt Satyagraha in Patna (April 1930), Endured Severe Colonial Police Brutality

birth_and_roots.background_context: Ambika Kant Sinha Patna ke ek committed nationalist parivar mein janme the. Padhai ke dauran hi ve Congress youth wing aur civil disobedience cadre se jud gaye the. Unka organizational control Patna City aur aas-paas ke rural blocks par tha. Jab 1930 mein Mahatma Gandhi ne Dandi March ke zariye Namak Kanoon toda, Bihar Provincial Congress Committee ne Patna mein Namak Satyagraha chalane ke liye Ambika Kant Sinha ko operational in-charge banaya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Patna Salt Satyagraha 1930, Battle of Nakhas Pind, Defiance of Police Mounted Horse Charges
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 16 April 1930 ko Ambika Kant Sinha ne Patna mein Namak Satyagraha lead kiya. Unhone Mangal Talaab ke paas 'Nakhas Pind' ko namak banane ka central ground select kiya. British police ne unka rasta block karne ke liye heavy lathicharge kiya aur ghodon se satyagrahis ko raundne ki koshish ki. Ambika Kant Sinha sadak par let gaye aur janta ko shant reh kar namak kanoon todne ke liye command karte rahe. Unhone physically namak banakar kanoon ko dismantle kiya. Police ne unhein brutal violence ke sath arrest kiya aur jail bhej diya. Unke is sahas ne Patna mein daily protests ka continuous stream chalu kiya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Directives to Patna Citizens to boycott imported salt and cloth
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Ambika Kant Sinha ka lead kiya gaya Nakhas Pind Satyagraha Bihar ke urban national movement ka turning point tha. Isne yeh dikha diya ki Bihar mein namak banane ke liye natural sea-shore na hone ke bawajood saline soil (mitti) se chemical process ke zariye namak kanoon toda ja sakta hai. Unke arrest ke baad Rajendra Prasad aur anya leaders ne movement ko expand kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Patna Namak Satyagraha ke frontline general hone ke karan unhein 'Nakhas Pind ka Senani' kaha gaya.
16 April 1930 ko Patna ke Nakhas Pind par police lathicharge ke beech namak bana kar civil disobedience perform karna.
Patna City ke Nakhas Pind memorial site par unke balidan ke shilalekh sthit hain.
BPSC Prelims: 'Patna mein Namak Satyagraha ka mukhya kendra kaun sa sthal tha aur iska netritva kisne kiya tha? (Nakhas Pind - Ambika Kant Sinha)'.

name: Prof. Abdul Bari (प्रोफ़ेसर अब्दुल बारी)
popular_title: Labor Tribune, Pioneer of Industrial Trade Unionism
qualifying_benchmark: President of Bihar Provincial Congress Committee, Supreme Leader of Tata Workers' Union (Jamshedpur), Non-Cooperation & Salt Satyagraha Veteran

birth_and_roots.background_context: Prof. Abdul Bari ka janam Bhojpur ke Koilwar mein ek respectable Muslim parivar mein hua tha. Patna College se M.A. aur Law karne ke baad ve Bihar National College (B.N. College, Patna) mein History ke Professor bane, jisse log unhein samman se 'Prof. Abdul Bari' kehne lage. 1920 ke Asahyog Andolan mein unhone professorship tyag di. Unka vyaktitva oajpurna bhashan, fearless confrontation aur labor class ke rights ke prati radical commitment ke liye jana jata tha.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO) Strikes, President of BPCC, Salt Satyagraha 1930, Communal Harmony Defense
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Prof. Abdul Bari ne Subhash Chandra Bose ke sath milkar Jamshedpur ke Tata steel workers ka iconic movement lead kiya aur 'Tata Workers' Union' ke President bane. Unhone Dalmianagar aur Dhanbad coal belts mein bhi working-class solidarity build ki. 1930 ke Namak Satyagraha aur 1942 ke Quit India Movement mein unhone Central Bihar mein militant mass rallies lead ki thin aur multiple times jail gaye. 1946 ke severe communal riots ke dauran unhone apni jaan jokhim mein daalkar hazaron innocent danga-peediton ko rescue kiya. March 1947 mein Khusrupur (Patna) ke paas ek mysterious police checkpoint firing incident mein unki tragic shahadat hui.

famous_works_or_edicts: Charters of Industrial Labor Rights at Jamshedpur and Asansol Belts
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Prof. Abdul Bari Bihar ke industrial trade unionism ke supreme mass leader the. Unke single call par Tata Steel ke hazaron shramik plants band kar dete the. Unhone yeh ensure kiya ki trade unions corporate exploitation se ladein bina national freedom struggle ke context ko bhule. Unki integrity aisi thi ki unpar kabhi koi management unka stand khareed nahi saki.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Mazdoor varg aur Congress organization mein unki fearless honesty ke karan unhein 'Bihar ke Mazdoor Kranti ka Sher' kaha gaya.
1937 mein Bihar Legislative Assembly ke Deputy Speaker banna aur 1930s-40s mein TISCO strikes ka successfully lead karna.
Jamshedpur mein 'Bari Maidan' aur Koilwar mein 'Abdul Bari Railway Bridge' unke samman mein dedicate kiya gaya hai.
BPSC History & Labor: 'Jamshedpur ke Tata Workers' Union ke neta aur Bihar Congress ke pramukh adhyaksh kaun the jinki 1947 mein hatya hui thi? (Prof. Abdul Bari)'.

name: Swami Bhavani Dayal Sanyasi (स्वामी भवानी दयाल संन्यासी)
popular_title: Pravasi Satyagrahi, Pravasi Bihariyon ke Masiha
qualifying_benchmark: Co-fighter with Mahatma Gandhi in South Africa, Leader of Bihar Salt Satyagraha & Girmitiya Rights

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Johannesburg, South Africa (Ancestral Roots: Bahuara village, Rohtas/Bhojpur), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Bhavani Dayal Sanyasi ka janam South Africa mein hua tha jahan unke pita Rohtas ke Bahuara gaon se Girmitiya (indentured laborer) ke roop mein gaye the. South Africa mein unhone Gandhi ji ke sath Satyagraha mein active combat kiya aur unki patni Janki Devi bhi jail gayin. Baad mein ve Bihar ke apne paitrik gaon Bahuara laut aaye aur wahan 'Pravasi Bhawan' setup kiya. Unhone dekha ki Bharat ki azaadi aur overseas Indian laborers ke human rights ek doosre se deeply interconnected hain.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: South African Indian Satyagraha, Bihar Salt Satyagraha 1930, Anti-Girmitiya Agitation, Hindi Journalism
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1930 ke Salt Satyagraha ke dauran unhone Shahabad aur Rohtas mein kisanon ko civil disobedience ke liye mobilize kiya jiske chalte unhein arrest karke 2.5 saal ke liye Hazaribagh Central Jail mein band kiya gaya. Jail ke andar unhone 'Karagar' naamak handwritten underground magazine circulate ki. Unhone Indian National Congress ke platform par overseas Indians aur Girmitiya mazdooron ke dukh-dard par national resolutions pass karwaye. Unhone Indian diaspora aur Bihar ke freedom struggle ke beech intellectual bridge banaya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Pravasi Ki Atmakatha (Autobiography)
Dakshin Africa Ke Satyagraha Ka Itihas
Vaidik Dharmanirnay
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Bhavani Dayal Sanyasi ki autobiography 'Pravasi Ki Atmakatha' diaspora history aur anti-colonial resistance ka classical masterpiece hai. Unhone Hindi patrikaon ke zariye British indenture system ki inhuman reality ko expose kiya jiske chalte colonial government ko Girmitiya recruitment par permanent bans lagane pade.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: South Africa aur Bharat dono jagah azaadi ke liye sanyas lekar ladne ke karan unhein 'Pravasi Satyagrahi' kaha gaya.
1930 Namak Satyagraha mein Hazaribagh jail term aur wahan 'Karagar' patrika chalana.
Bahuara (Rohtas) mein Pravasi Bhawan dharohar ke roop mein sthit hai; Hindi sahitya mein unka research cited hai.
BPSC History: 'Pravasi Ki Atmakatha pustak kisne likhi hai aur unka sambandh Bihar ke kis zile se tha? (Swami Bhavani Dayal Sanyasi - Rohtas)'.

name: Baikuntha Shukla (बैकुंठ शुक्ल)
popular_title: Amar Shaheed of HSRA, Betrayal Punisher
qualifying_benchmark: HSRA Revolutionary, Executed British Approver Phanindra Nath Ghosh (1932) to Avenge Bhagat Singh, Hanged at Gaya Jail (1934)

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Jalalpur village, Lalganj, Vaishali district (erstwhile Muzaffarpur), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Baikuntha Shukla ka janam Vaishali ke Jalalpur gaon ke ek patriotic kisan parivar mein hua tha. Ve mahan krantikari Yogendra Shukla ke bhatije the. Bachpan se hi unke ghar par krantikariyon ka aana-jana tha. Unhone primary school teacher ke roop mein karya kiya par 1930 ke Namak Satyagraha mein Patna aur Muzaffarpur mein actively participate karke jail gaye. Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) ke revolutionary ideology aur Bhagat Singh ke martyrdom ne unke jeevan ko armed underground martyrdom ke raste par permanently establish kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Assassination of Traitor Phanindra Nath Ghosh, HSRA Underground Operations, Gaya Jail Martyrdom
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Lahore Conspiracy Case trial mein Phanindra Nath Ghosh Britishers ka government approver (gawah) ban gaya tha, jiske jhoothe bayaan ke chalte Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev aur Rajguru ko phansi hui thi. HSRA leadership ne Ghosh ko death sentence pass ki aur yeh task Baikuntha Shukla aur Chandrama Singh ko diya gaya. 9 November 1932 ko Bettiah ke Meena Bazaar mein unhone cycle par ja rahe Phanindra Nath Ghosh par dagger (chhura) se lethal attack karke use maar giraya. Is sensational attack ne British empire ko shock kar diya. Kadi chase ke baad unhein Kanpur railway station par arrest kiya gaya. 14 May 1934 ko Gaya Central Jail mein unhein phansi de di gayi.

institutions_or_initiatives: Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA, Bihar Unit)
famous_works_or_edicts: Court Statements expressing pride in avenging the martyrdom of Bhagat Singh
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Baikuntha Shukla ne yeh establish kiya ki Indian revolutionary movement mein betrayers aur traitors ke liye koi mercy nahi thi. Unki execution ne poor North Bihar ke youth ke bheetar revolutionary courage bhar diya. Gaya Central Jail mein unki hanging ke waqt unka weight badh gaya tha jo unke unshakeable patriotic resolve ka biological praman mana gaya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Bhagat Singh ki phansi ka badla lene wale HSRA ke supreme hero ke roop mein unhein 'Amar Shaheed' ka darja mila.
9 November 1932 ko Bettiah mein approver Phanindra Nath Ghosh ko maut ke ghaat utarna aur 14 May 1934 ko Gaya Jail mein phansi.
Gaya Central Jail mein unka Shaheed Smarak sthit hai; Lalganj (Vaishali) mein unke naam par memorial sthal sthit hain.

BPSC Prelims: 'Bhagat Singh ke khilaf gawaahi dene wale Phanindra Nath Ghosh ki hatya kisne ki thi? (Baikuntha Shukla)' tatha 'Baikuntha Shukla ko kis jail mein phansi di gayi thi? (Gaya Jail, 1934)'.

name: Yogendra Shukla (योगेंद्र शुक्ल)
popular_title: Senior Leader of HSRA Bihar, Master of Revolutionary Raids
qualifying_benchmark: Convicted in Tirhut Conspiracy Case, Transported to Cellular Jail (Kalapani), Scaled Hazaribagh Central Jail Walls with JP in 1942

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Jalalpur village, Lalganj, Vaishali district (erstwhile Muzaffarpur), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Yogendra Shukla ka janam Vaishali ke Jalalpur gaon ke ek sanskritik aur sangharshsheel kisan parivar mein hua tha. Ve Baikuntha Shukla ke chacha the. Shuruat se hi unka sharir asadharan roop se balshali aur man krantikari rashtravad se prerit tha. Unhone Non-Cooperation Movement ke dauran azaadi ke andolan mein entry li, par Gandhi ji dwara movement wapas lene ke baad ve armed revolution ki taraf mude. Sachindra Nath Sanyal aur Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) ke contact mein aakar unhone Bihar unit ke military command ki zimmedari li.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Armed Revolutionary Dacoities for Funds, Tirhut Conspiracy Case, Hazaribagh Jail Escape 1942, Azad Dasta Military Operations
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Yogendra Shukla ne HSRA ke liye arms purchase aur bomb testing funds jutane ke liye Maulania aur Dheluahan mein daring revolutionary dacoities lead ki thin. 1930 mein unhein arrest kiya gaya aur famous 'Tirhut Conspiracy Case' mein unhein rigorous imprisonment dekar Andamans ke Cellular Jail (Kalapani) deport kiya gaya, jahan unhone political prisoners ke rights ke liye historic hunger strikes lead ki. 1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan ke samay ve Hazaribagh Central Jail mein band the. Diwali 1942 ki raat unhone Jayaprakash Narayan, Suraj Narayan Singh aur Rambriksh Benipuri ke sath milkar jail ki vishal deewar phandi aur Nepal Terai jakar Azad Dasta ke trainees ko direct warfare techniques sikhayi.

institutions_or_initiatives: Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA, Bihar Unit Commander)
famous_works_or_edicts: Revolutionary training circulars on arms handling and clandestine communication
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Yogendra Shukla Bihar ke underground armed resistance ke supreme operational pillar the. Unka organizational reach North Bihar ke Tirhut se lekar Chota Nagpur ke tribal belts tak tha. Unhone youth ko physical conditioning, shooting aur police pursuit se bachne ke guerrilla techniques mein train kiya. Unke tyag aur Kalapani ke physical torture ne unhein Bihar ke freedom struggle ka legend banaya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: HSRA ke underground circuits mein unki iron will aur physical endurance ke chalte unhein 'Bihar ke Kranti-Purush' kaha jata tha.
Diwali 1942 ko Hazaribagh Central Jail se Jayaprakash Narayan ke sath safal jail break.
Lalganj (Vaishali) aur Muzaffarpur mein unke smarak aur educational institutes operational hain.
BPSC Prelims: '1942 mein Hazaribagh jail se JP ke sath bhagne wale pramukh krantikari kaun the? (Yogendra Shukla)' tatha 'Tirhut Conspiracy Case kisse juda tha?'

name: Batukeshwar Dutt (बटुकेश्वर दत्त)
popular_title: BK Dutt, Central Assembly Bomb Hero
qualifying_benchmark: Co-bombed Central Legislative Assembly with Bhagat Singh (8 April 1929), Sentenced to Life Transportation at Cellular Jail (Kalapani)

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Oari village, Khandaghosh, Burdwan (Karmabhoomi & Final Residence: Jakkanpur, Patna), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Batukeshwar Dutt ka janam Bengal ke Burdwan mein hua tha, par unka parivar aur karmabhoomi deep-rooted roop se Kanpur aur baad mein sthayi roop se Patna (Bihar) ban gayi. Kanpur mein unki mulakat Chandrashekhar Azad aur Bhagat Singh se hui aur ve Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) ke active bomb-making operative bane. Unhone Bengal aur Bihar ke beech revolutionary network establish kiya. Azaadi ke andolan ke dauran aur azaadi ke baad ve Patna ke Jakkanpur mohalle mein settled rahe aur unka poora public life Bihar ke social aur labor movements ke sath integrate raha.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Central Legislative Assembly Bomb Action 1929, Historic Hunger Strikes in Cellular Jail, 1942 Quit India Agitation in Patna
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 8 April 1929 ko Batukeshwar Dutt ne Bhagat Singh ke sath milkar Delhi ke Central Legislative Assembly mein Public Safety Bill aur Trade Disputes Bill ke virodh mein low-intensity harmless smoke bombs phenke aur 'Inquilab Zindabad' ke naare lagaye. Unka intention kisi ko maarna nahi balki behri colonial sarkar ko sunana tha. Unhone voluntarily arrest di. Unhein life imprisonment dekar Andamans ke Cellular Jail (Kalapani) bheja gaya jahan unhone political prisoners ke human treatment ke liye record historic hunger strikes ki. 1938 mein release hone ke baad unhone Patna ko apna headquarters banaya aur 1942 ke Quit India Movement mein participate karke fir se jail gaye.

famous_works_or_edicts: Historic Pamphlet: 'To Make the Deaf Hear' thrown in Central Assembly (1929)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: BK Dutt ne Bhagat Singh ke sath milkar 'Inquilab Zindabad' naare ko Indian masses ka official war-cry bana diya. Unhone court statements mein socialist revolution aur working class rule ki theoretical foundation rakhi. Azaadi ke baad Patna mein rehte hue unhone transport workers aur unorganized laborers ke self-respect ke liye silent service ki.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: National movement mein unhein samman se 'BK Dutt' aur Central Assembly action ka immortal hero mana gaya.
8 April 1929 ko Delhi Assembly mein bomb dhamaka aur leaflets ka distribution.
Hussainiwala (Punjab) mein Bhagat Singh, Rajguru, aur Sukhdev ke sath unka samadhi sthal sthit hai; Patna ke Jakkanpur mein unka aawash historical memorial hai.
BPSC Prelims & Mains: '8 April 1929 ko Central Legislative Assembly mein Bhagat Singh ke sath bomb kisne phenka tha? (Batukeshwar Dutt)' tatha 'BK Dutt ka Bihar se kya sambandh raha?'

name: Chhabilal (Chhedi) Nonia (छबिलाल / छेदी नोनिया)
popular_title: 1857 Shahabad Insurgent Martyr
qualifying_benchmark: Revolutionary Insurgent of Veer Kunwar Singh's Force, Executed by British for Sabotaging Military Communications

birth_and_roots.background_context: Chhabilal Nonia (jinhein local records mein Chhedi Nonia bhi kaha gaya) Shahabad ke ek subaltern Nonia (traditional saltpeter/shora manufacturer) kisan parivar se the. Nonia community traditional explosives, gunpowder preparation aur earthen fortifications ke nirmarn mein expert thi. Veer Kunwar Singh ne jab British shasan ke khilaf baghavat ka ailan kiya, tab Shahabad ke subaltern artisans aur kisanon ne revolutionary logistics ko maintain karne ke liye hathiyar uthaye. Chhabilal Nonia ne is grassroots technical combat group ko lead kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: 1857 Guerrilla Sabotage, Destruction of British Telegraph and Postal Lines, Supply of Explosives to Rebel Army
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1857-1858 ke dauran Chhabilal Nonia ne Veer Kunwar Singh aur Amar Singh ke troops ke liye crude gunpowder prepare kiya aur Arrah-Sasaram road par British army ke supply columns ko disrupt kiya. Unhone Grand Trunk Road aur Son river transit routes par British postal runners aur military telegraph wires ko cut karne ka daredevil operation lead kiya, jisse British military command Patna aur Benares ke beech isolated ho gayi. British counter-insurgency forces ne inquiry ke dauran unhein ambush karke capture kiya aur bina kisi regular court procedure ke military summary trial chala kar publically hanging par execute kar diya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Subaltern resistance songs commemorating the disruption of company dak
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Chhabilal Nonia ka sacrifice yeh establish karta hai ki 1857 ka Great Revolt sirf feudal princes aur sepoys ka yuddh nahi tha, balki ismein artisanal aur backward communities ne technical support aur life-and-death resistance diya. Unka sabotage model Shahabad mein British mobility ko restrict karne mein decisive tha.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Bhojpur ke subaltern folklore mein unhein '1857 ka Baaghi Nonia' ke roop mein sammaan mila.
Shahabad mein British communications ko kaatne ke jurm mein colonial troops dwara execution.
Bihar government ke freedom movement archives aur Bhojpur martyrs register mein unka naam documented hai.
BPSC History & Subaltern Resistance: '1857 ke vidroh ke dauran Shahabad kshetra mein British communications ko disrupt karne wale krantikari kaun the? (Chhabilal/Chhedi Nonia)'.

name: Suraj Narayan Singh (सूरज नारायण सिंह)
popular_title: Senapati of Azad Dasta
qualifying_benchmark: Escaped Hazaribagh Jail with JP (1942), Chief Military Instructor of Azad Dasta, Liberated JP & Lohia from Hanumannagar Jail

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Kalikapur village, Madhubani district (erstwhile Darbhanga), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Suraj Narayan Singh ka janam Madhubani ke Kalikapur gaon ke ek kisan Rajput parivar mein hua tha. Shuruati shiksha ke baad ve radical socialist aur anti-colonial movements ki taraf attract hue. Unka physical framework commanding tha aur unhein martial arts, boxing aur firearms handling ka master mana jata tha. Mithilanchal ke sharecroppers ke shoshan aur British imperialism ke khilaf unke andar violent aakrosh tha. Ve Congress Socialist Party ke armed youth wing ke natural leader bane.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Hazaribagh Jail Break 1942, Azad Dasta Weapons Training, Hanumannagar Jail Armed Assault (Nepal)
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: November 1942 mein Diwali ki raat unhone Jayaprakash Narayan ko apni peeth aur kandhon par uthakar Hazaribagh Central Jail ki 18-foot unchi deewar paar karwayi. Nepal ke Bakro Ka Tapu jungle mein sthit 'Azad Dasta' ke guerrilla camp mein unhein Chief Military Instructor banaya gaya, jahan unhone yuvakon ko firearms aur bomb tactics train kiye. May 1943 mein jab Nepal police ne JP aur Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia ko arrest karke Hanumannagar Jail mein band kiya, Suraj Narayan Singh ne akelay armed squad lead karke jail par raid maari, police guards ko overpower kiya aur dono leaders ko successfully liberate karwaya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Tactical Guerrilla Training Manual of Azad Dasta (1942)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Suraj Narayan Singh Azad Dasta ke action-arm ke spine the. Agar ve Hanumannagar jail par raid na maarte toh Britishers JP aur Lohia ko capture karke secretively eliminate kar sakte the. Azaadi ke baad unhone Praja Socialist Party aur socialist movements mein active role nibhaya aur Bihar Legislative Assembly mein MLA aur opposition leader rahe.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Azad Dasta ke armed military operations ke fearless execution ke karan unhein 'Azad Dasta ka Senapati' kaha gaya.
May 1943 mein Nepal sthit Hanumannagar jail par successful armed assault karke JP aur Dr. Lohia ko rescue karwana.
Madhubani aur Patna mein Suraj Narayan Singh smriti institutions operational hain; state war annals mein unka naam immortalized hai.
BPSC Prelims: '1943 mein Nepal ki Hanumannagar jail par hamla karke Jayaprakash Narayan aur Lohia ko kisne azaad karwaya tha? (Suraj Narayan Singh)'.

name: Siyaram Singh (सियाराम सिंह)
popular_title: Sardar Siyaram Singh, Hero of Siyaram Dal
qualifying_benchmark: Founder and Supreme Commander of Siyaram Dal (1942), Ran Independent Guerrilla Parallel Administration in Eastern Bihar

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Tilakpur village, Sultanganj, Bhagalpur district, Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Siyaram Singh ka janam Bhagalpur ke Sultanganj ke paas Tilakpur gaon mein ek kisan parivar mein hua tha. Bhagalpur aur Ang kshetra shuru se Tilka Manjhi ke vidroh aur revolutionary nationalism ke liye jana jata tha. Gandhi ji ke Asahyog Andolan aur 1930 ke Namak Satyagraha mein unhone young volunteer ke roop mein participate kiya. 1942 mein jab British government ne Congress ke top leaders ko arrest kiya, Siyaram Singh ne armed guerrilla resistance ke zariye colonial administrative machinery ko destroy karne ka rasta chuna.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Foundation of Siyaram Dal, Capture of Police Stations, Protection of Village Crops, Parallel Administration in Ang Region
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: August 1942 mein unhone 'Siyaram Dal' ki sthapna ki jismein hazaron armed youth shamil hue. Is Dal ne Bhagalpur, Munger, Purnia aur Santhal Parganas mein parallel government chalayi. Siyaram Dal ne Sonbarsa, Bihpur aur Sultanganj ke police thanas aur post offices ko torch kiya aur weapons capture kiye. Unhone boat fleets par kabja karke Ganga river route par British movement block kar diya. Siyaram Singh ne village grain banks banaye aur zamindaron dwara kisanon ki loot par rok lagayi. British administration ne unpar Rs 5,000 ka cash bounty announce kiya par unhein azaadi tak arrest nahi kiya ja saka.

famous_works_or_edicts: Code of Conduct for Siyaram Dal Volunteers (Strict defense of women and poor villagers)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Siyaram Dal ka code of conduct itna strict tha ki kisi bhi member ko personal property ya common citizen par attack karne ki permission nahi thi; target sirf colonial police, railway installations aur government treasuries the. Is discipline ke chalte Eastern Bihar ke hazaron dehati parivaron ne British police terror ke samne unhein hideouts aur food provide kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Eastern Bihar mein impenetrable guerrilla military network command karne ke karan unhein 'Sardar' Siyaram Singh kaha gaya.
1942 mein Siyaram Dal ka gathan karke Bhagalpur-Munger division mein complete parallel governance execute karna.
Tilakpur (Sultanganj) mein unka smarak sthit hai; state archives mein Siyaram Dal ka dossier sanrakshit hai.
BPSC Prelims & Mains: '1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan ke dauran Bhagalpur mein kisne 'Siyaram Dal' ka gathan kiya tha? (Siyaram Singh)'.

name: Karpuri Thakur (कर्पूरी ठाकुर)
popular_title: Jan Nayak (जननायक)
qualifying_benchmark: Bharat Ratna 2024, Imprisoned for 26 Months during 1942 Quit India Movement, Architect of Social Justice Governance

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Pitaunjhia (now Karpuri Gram), Samastipur district (erstwhile Darbhanga), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Karpuri Thakur ka janam Pitaunjhia gaon mein ek marginalized 'Nai' (barber) jati ke atyant garib kisan parivar mein hua tha. Gaon mein unhone bhedbhav, caste discrimination aur feudal dominance ko jhela. Unhone C.M. College Darbhanga se padhai shuru ki par Quit India Movement 1942 mein kood pade. Unpar Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia, Acharya Narendra Deva aur Jayaprakash Narayan ke socialist darshan ka complete impact tha. Unka poora jeevan sadagi, honest austerity aur backward-depressed classes ko political power dilane ke liye samarpit raha.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Quit India Movement 1942, Subaltern Mass Mobilization, Chief Minister of Bihar (1970–71, 1977–79), Tiered Reservation Model 1978
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: August 1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan ke dauran young Karpuri Thakur ne college chhod diya aur Samastipur aur Darbhanga ke rural pockets mein militant student agitations lead kiye. Unhone British government offices ke gherao aur secret communication distribution ko coordinate kiya, jiske chalte unhein arrest karke 26 mahine tak Darbhanga aur Bhagalpur Central Jailon mein rigorous imprisonment di gayi. Post-independence unhone socialist movement lead kiya aur Bihar ke Chief Minister banne par unhone English ki matric compulsory requirement hatayi, total prohibition lagu kiya aur 1978 mein landmark Karpoori Thakur Formula lagu kiya.

institutions_or_initiatives: All India Backward Classes Federation associate
famous_works_or_edicts: Karpoori Formula Notification (November 1978)
Policy on Free Secondary School Education for Backward Classes
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Karpuri Thakur ne modern India ke affirmative action policies ka blueprint taiyar kiya. Unka 1978 ka formula OBC quota ke bheetar Extremely Backward Classes (EBC) aur women ko institutional reservation dene wala pehla model tha jisne Mandal Commission ko theoretical base diya. Unhein 2024 mein maranoparant 'Bharat Ratna' se alankrit kiya gaya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Garibon, shoshiton aur pichhdon ke nisprah sevak hone ke karan aam janta ne unhein aadar se 'Jan Nayak' (People's Hero) ka khitab diya.
1942 Quit India movement mein 26 mahine ki jail yatra aur November 1978 mein historic tiered reservation model lagu karna.
Bharat Ratna (2024); unke janm gaon Pitaunjhia ka naam badal kar 'Karpuri Gram' kiya gaya; Patna mein Karpoori Thakur Museum sthit hai.
BPSC Prelims & Mains: 'Jan Nayak kise kaha jata hai? (Karpuri Thakur)', 'Mungeri Lal Commission ki sifarishon ko lagu karne wale Mukhyamantri kaun the?' tatha 'Bharat Ratna 2024 kise diya gaya?'

name: Basawon Singh / Sinha (बसावन सिंह)
popular_title: Lambardar of Labor Resistance, Fearless Revolutionary
qualifying_benchmark: Co-founder of Congress Socialist Party (1934), Supreme Pioneer of Industrial & Agrarian Trade Unionism in Bihar

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Subhai village, Hajipur, Vaishali district, Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Basawon Singh ka janam Vaishali ke Subhai gaon mein ek kisan parivar mein hua tha. Unhone school ke dinon se hi revolutionary terrorism aur Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) ke underground activists se sampark banaya. Sachindra Nath Sanyal aur Yogendra Shukla ke shishya ke roop mein unhone direct armed action ka rasta chuna. Lahore Conspiracy Case aur anya political conspiracy cases mein unka naam aaya. Unhone mehsoos kiya ki colonial rule ke sath-sath corporate aur feudal exploitation ko ukhadne ke liye factory mazdooron aur khetiharon ka armed trade unionism zaroori hai.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Trade Union Movement in Dalmianagar & Jamshedpur, 1942 Underground Sabotage, Congress Socialist Party
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Basawon Singh ne Bihar mein organized labor strikes ki neev rakhi. 1930s-40s mein unhone Dalmianagar ke Rohtas Industries mein Asia ki sabse badi industrial worker strike lead ki, jahan unhone industrial barons ko workers ke demands man-ne par majboor kiya. Unhone Jamshedpur, Khas Jealgora coal mines aur railway unions ko lead kiya. 1942 ke Quit India Movement ke dauran ve underground hokar central India aur Bihar ke beech guerrilla strikes organize karte rahe. Unhein multiple baar arrest karke torture kiya gaya aur unhone British jailon mein lambi bhookh hartalein kin.

institutions_or_initiatives: Founder President, Rohtas Industries Mazdoor Sangh
famous_works_or_edicts: Labor Rights Charter of Dalmianagar and Jamshedpur Industrial Belts
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Basawon Singh ne Bihar ke industrial aur agrarian labor movement ko violent muscle-power se nikaal kar organized collective bargaining power mein convert kiya. Unki patni Kamaladevi Sinha swayam ek prominent activist thin. Unhone railway, coal mines, sugar mills aur paper factories ke shramikon ko national freedom struggle ka shock-troop banaya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Mazdooron ke adhikaaron ke liye unbroken strike actions lead karne ke karan unhein 'Bihar ke Mazdoor Andolan ke Bhishma' kaha gaya.
1938-1939 mein Dalmianagar mein massive general strike lead karke labor rights establish karwana.
Dalmianagar aur Patna mein Basawon Singh Indoor Stadium aur trade union complexes unke naam par chal rahe hain.
BPSC Modern History & Labor: 'Bihar mein Dalmianagar aur Jamshedpur ke kshetron mein prabhavshali mazdoor andolan lead karne wale socialist neta kaun the? (Basawon Singh)'.

name: Prabhavati Devi (प्रभावती देवी)
popular_title: Gandhian Matrishakti of Bihar, Bapu ki Beti
qualifying_benchmark: Foremost Woman Leader of Civil Disobedience & 1942 Movement in Bihar, Founder of Mahila Charkha Samiti (1940)

birth_and_roots.background_context: Prabhavati Devi veteran nationalist leader Babu Brajkishore Prasad ki suputri thin. Unka vivah Jayaprakash Narayan (JP) ke sath hua tha. Jab JP America padhai ke liye gaye, Prabhavati Devi ne Mahatma Gandhi ke Sabarmati Ashram mein rehkar sadhana ki jahan Kasturba Gandhi aur Bapu unhein apni beti mante the. Unhone Brahmacharya aur total public service ka ajeevan sankalp liya. Unka intellectual orientation pure Gandhian constructive program (Khadi, women literacy, untouchability removal) aur national resistance par aadharit tha.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Salt Satyagraha 1930, 1942 Underground Communication, Mahila Charkha Samiti, Rehabilitation of Victims
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1930 ke Namak Satyagraha aur 1932 ke Civil Disobedience Movement mein unhone Patna mein female processions lead kiye aur British police lathicharge ka saamna kiya. Unhein arrest karke Arthur Road Jail Mumbai aur baad mein Bihar ki jailon mein solitary confinement mein rakha gaya. 1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan ke dauran jab JP Hazaribagh jail se bhage aur underground hue, Prabhavati Devi underground leaders ke beech secret couriers, funds aur messages transfer karne ka central nerve-center sambhalti thin. Unhone Patna mein 'Mahila Charkha Samiti' sthapit karke destitute women ko economic self-reliance diya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Writings and letters on Women's Self-Reliance and Charkha Constructive Program
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Prabhavati Devi ka Kadamkuan (Patna) sthit 'Charkha Samiti' azaadi ke andolan ke dauran nationalist women ka headquarters tha. Unhone purdah-system ko dismantle karke hazaron Bihari mahilaon ko street protests mein utara. JP ke political stand ke piche Prabhavati Devi ki moral conviction sabse decisive power thi.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Sabarmati Ashram mein Gandhi ji dwara unhein aadar se 'Bapu ki Beti' aur Bihar ki Tyag-Murti kaha gaya.
1930s mein multiple jail confinements aur 1940 mein Mahila Charkha Samiti ki sthapna.
Patna ke Kadamkuan mein Prabhavati Devi Mahila Charkha Samiti operational dharohar hai; Patna mein Prabhavati Hospital unke naam par sthit hai.
BPSC Prelims: 'Jayaprakash Narayan ki patni ka kya naam tha jinhone Bihar mein Mahila Charkha Samiti sthapit ki thi? (Prabhavati Devi)'.

name: Saraswati Devi (सरस्वती देवी)
popular_title: Agni-Kanya of Hazaribagh
qualifying_benchmark: Supreme Female Leader of Non-Cooperation & 1942 Movement in Chota Nagpur, Rescued from Police Custody by Students

birth_and_roots.background_context: Saraswati Devi Hazaribagh ke ek nationalist parivar se thin. Unhone Chota Nagpur plateau ke backward aur tribal women ke beech azaadi ki chetna jagane ka sankalp liya. 1920s ke Asahyog Andolan se lekar 1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan tak ve Chota Nagpur division mein Congress aur national resistance ki undisputed commanding woman leader thin. Unka bhashan itna fiery hota tha ki police unke speech deliver karne se pehle hi section 144 impose kar deti thi.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Salt Satyagraha in Hazaribagh, Rescue from Police Custody by Students (1942), Boycott of Foreign Cloth
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1930 ke Namak Satyagraha mein unhone Hazaribagh town mein women's rally lead karke direct salt manufacture kiya aur arrest hui. 11 August 1942 ko Bharat Chhodo Andolan ke dauran unhein Hazaribagh mein arrest karke police van se Bhagalpur Jail le jaya ja raha tha. Raste mein Bagodar ke paas local students aur youth ne police bus ko gher liya, police guards ko disarm kiya aur Saraswati Devi ko successfully police custody se chhudwa liya. Unhone bahar nikal kar wapas rally lead ki aur baad mein self-arrest dekar Bhagalpur Central Jail gayin jahan unhone female prisoners ke sath movement zinda rakha.

famous_works_or_edicts: Appeals to Chota Nagpur Youth to paralyze British extractive bureaucracy (1942)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Saraswati Devi ka Bagodar rescue incident 1942 ke Quit India Movement ka legendary episode hai. Unhone yeh prove kiya ki Chota Nagpur ka student community apne leaders ko bachane ke liye police firing ka risk lene ko taiyar tha. Unki leadership ne tribal aur non-tribal women ko mass proportions mein street agitations mein join karne ke liye inspire kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Hazaribagh aur Chota Nagpur mein unki fierce oratorical courage ke chalte unhein 'Chota Nagpur ki Rani Laxmibai' kaha gaya.
August 1942 mein police custody se students dwara rescue karwaya jana aur fir se rally lead karna.
Hazaribagh ke swatantrata senani memorials aur Bihar-Jharkhand archives mein unki biography documented hai.
BPSC Prelims: '1942 ke azaadi andolan ke dauran Hazaribagh se arrest hui kis mahila neta ko vidyarthiyon ne police custody se chhudwa liya tha? (Saraswati Devi)'.

name: Tara Rani Srivastava (तारा रानी श्रीवास्तव)
popular_title: Heroine of Siwan Police Station Siege (1942)
qualifying_benchmark: Led Historic Siege on Siwan Police Station (1942), Bandaged Mortally Wounded Husband and Hoisted the National Flag

birth_and_roots.background_context: Tara Rani Srivastava ka janam Saran ke Dighwara qasbe ke ek patriotic Kayastha parivar mein hua tha. Unka vivah Siwan ke dedicated freedom fighter Phulendu Prasad Srivastava (Phulendu Babu) ke sath hua. Dono pati-patni ne apna ghar-baar azaadi ke andolan ke liye samarpit kar diya tha. 1942 ke Mahatma Gandhi ke 'Do or Die' (Karo ya Maro) aavhan ke baad unhone Siwan ke dehati logon ko organize karke British authority ke symbols (thanas aur kachehris) ko directly capture karne ka sankalp liya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Siege of Siwan Police Station (August 1942), Defiance of British Bullets, Flag Hoisting under Fire
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 12 August 1942 ko Tara Rani aur unke pati Phulendu Babu ne ek vishal tricolour-holding bheed ke sath Siwan Police Station par chadhayi ki. Police ne bheed ko titar-bitar karne ke liye direct rifle firing open kar di. Phulendu Babu ko police bullet seene mein lagi aur ve gir pade.
