Tara Rani ne aam auraton ki tarah rone ya piche hatne ke bajaye apni saree ka pallu phad kar pati ke wound ko tightly baandha aur crowd ko lalkara ki march nahi rukegi. Ve tiranga lekar aage badhin aur police bullets ke beech station ke top par tricolour hoist kiya. Wapas aane par unhone pati ko dam todte paya par unhone aakhri saans tak surrender nahi kiya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Call to rural women to hold the tricolor even if their husbands fall to bullets
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Tara Rani Srivastava ka balidan Indian freedom struggle mein unmatched courage ka symbol hai. Ek patni dwara apne ghaayal pati ko run-kshetra mein chhodkar flag hoisting mission ko complete karna subaltern patriotism ka supreme height tha. Unhone underground hokar aage bhi movement ko sustain kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Siwan thana par goli chalne ke bawajood tiranga phahrane ke adbhut sahas ke karan unhein 'Siwan ki Veerangana' kaha gaya.
August 1942 mein Siwan police station par apne pati ke shahadat ke dauran national flag unfurl karna.
Siwan mein unke samman mein memorial sthit hai; NCERT aur BPSC textbooks mein unki biography chapter ke roop mein shaamil hai.

BPSC Prelims & Mains: '1942 ke andolan ke dauran Siwan police station par tiranga lehrane ke dauran goli lagne se shaheed hue Phulendu Babu ki patni kaun thin jinhone jhanda phahraya tha? (Tara Rani Srivastava)'.

name: Phulendu Prasad Srivastava (फूलेंदु प्रसाद श्रीवास्तव)
popular_title: Hero Martyr of Siwan Thana (1942)
qualifying_benchmark: Supreme Martyr of 1942 Movement at Siwan Police Station, Led Mass Unfurling March under Police Gunfire

birth_and_roots.background_context: Phulendu Prasad Srivastava (jinhein Phulendu Babu kaha jata tha) Siwan ke ek fearless nationalist parivar se the. Tara Rani Srivastava ke pati the. Unhone student life se hi Congress youth wing aur socialist underground circles mein active work kiya tha. Saran aur Siwan region jo swatantrata sangram ka boiling point tha, wahan Phulendu Babu ne kisanon aur mazdooron ko direct political action ke liye inspire kiya. Unka sankalp tha ki British administrative power ko Siwan se physically eliminate kiya jaye.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Direct Action in Quit India 1942, Attack on Siwan Thana, Supreme Battlefield Martyrdom
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 12 August 1942 ko unhone apni patni Tara Rani Srivastava ke sath milkar Siwan thana par kabja karne ke liye hazaron logon ka juloos lead kiya. Thana ke aage British police ne unhein warning di par Phulendu Babu haath mein tiranga pakad kar aage badhte rahe. British police daroga ke order par unpar seedhi firing ki gayi. Unke seene aur pet mein multiple bullets lagin. Zameen par girte hue bhi unhone national flag ko zameen par nahi girne diya aur apni patni ko flag handover kiya. Wahi ran-kshetra mein kuch hi der baad unhone azaadi ke liye apna sarvochha balidan diya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Speeches advocating the capture of colonial police stations across Saran
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Phulendu Prasad Srivastava ka balidan 1942 ke Saran region ke mass uprising ka turning point bana. Unki shahadat ke baad agle din hazaron logon ne railway stations aur administrative offices par aag laga di aur British administration ko Kai dino tak Siwan se bhaagna pada.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: 1942 ke andolan mein Siwan thana firing ke mukhya shaheed ke roop mein unhein 'Amar Balidani Phulendu Babu' kaha jata hai.
12 August 1942 ko Siwan police station ke samne British bullets ka samna karte hue veer-gati paana.
Siwan Town mein unka Shahid Smarak sthit hai jahan annual public tributes aayojit hote hain.
BPSC State History: 'Siwan thana par 1942 mein tiranga phahrane ke prayas mein kaun se mukhya krantikari shaheed hue the? (Phulendu Prasad Srivastava)'.

name: Dhruv Kumar / Shaheed Dhruv (ध्रुव कुमार / शहीद ध्रुव)
popular_title: Bal Shahid of Katihar
qualifying_benchmark: 13-Year-Old Child Martyr of 1942 Movement at Katihar Police Station, Shot Dead while Carrying the Tricolor

birth_and_roots.background_context: Dhruv Kumar Katihar ke ek rashtravadi kisan parivar mein janme the. Unke pita Kishori Lal Kundu swayam Congress ke committed activist the. Mahaz 13 varsh ki aayu mein unke andar deshbhakti aur tirange ke prati asadharan prem tha. 1942 mein jab Gandhi ji aur Rajendra Prasad arrest hue, tab Purnia-Katihar ke schools aur colleges ke chhatra road par utar aaye. Dhruv Kumar ne school chhod kar baal-vanar sena aur student protest squads ka lead liya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Katihar Thana March (13 August 1942), Student Resistance, Supreme Child Martyrdom under British Fire
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 13 August 1942 ko Katihar mein vidyarthiyon aur aam janta ka ek vishal juloos nikla jiska nishana Katihar Police Station par tiranga lehrana tha. 13-saal ke Dhruv Kumar sabse aage haath mein national flag pakad kar chal rahe the. British police officers ne firing ka order diya. Police bullets seedhe chhotey Dhruv ke seene mein lagin. Dhruv zameen par gir pade, unka shareer khoon se latpath tha par unke nanhe haathon ne tiranga nahi chhoda. Thodi der mein unki shahadat ho gayi. Is tragic child murder ne poore Seemanchal aur Bihar mein aisi aag lagayi ki agle hi din Katihar railway junction aur administrative posts capture kar liye gaye.

famous_works_or_edicts: National Slogans of 13 August 1942 Katihar March
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Shaheed Dhruv ki shahadat ne yeh pramanit kiya ki 1942 ka movement bachhon ke dilon tak pahunch chuka tha. Unke balidan ke baad unke pita Kishori Lal Kundu ne aasu bahane ke bajaye kaha ki unhein garv hai ki unka beta rashtra ke liye shaheed hua. Unke balidan par Phanishwar Nath Renu aur anya sahityakaron ne inspirational accounts likhe.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Katihar mein 13 varsh ki komal aayu mein shahadat paane ke karan unhein 'Shaheed Dhruv' aur 'Bihar ka Veer Balak' kaha gaya.
13 August 1942 ko Katihar thana ke samne British police firing mein martyrdom.
Katihar mein 'Dhruv Kundu Memorial Park' aur 'Shaheed Dhruv Smarak' sthit hai; state schools unki shahadat celebrate karte hain.
BPSC Prelims: '13 August 1942 ko Katihar thana par tiranga lehrate waqt police goli se shaheed hone wale 13-varshiya balak ka kya naam tha? (Dhruv Kumar / Shaheed Dhruv)'.

name: Jaglal Chaudhary (जगलाल चौधरी)
popular_title: Dalit Kesari of Saran, Total Prohibition Crusader
qualifying_benchmark: Led Armed Assault on Garkha Thana (1942), Sentenced to 10 Years Rigorous Imprisonment, Minister in Sri Babu's 1937 & 1946 Cabinets

birth_and_roots.background_context: Jaglal Chaudhary ka janam Saran ke Garkha gaon mein ek marginalized Pasi (Dalit) parivar mein hua tha. Patna College aur Medical College mein unhone shiksha arjit ki. 1921 ke Asahyog Andolan ke dauran unhone apni secure medical padhai chhod di aur Gandhi ji ke movement mein join kiya. Saran belt mein Dalit upliftment, kheti, aur taadi-vyavsay se jude shoshit logon ke rehabilitation ke liye unhone ajeevan ladai ladi. Unka vyaktitva high moral principles aur radical peasant action ka mishran tha.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Non-Cooperation Movement 1921, Attack on Garkha Police Station 1942, Excise Minister (Total Prohibition Enactor), Dalit Emancipation
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1942 ke Quit India Movement ke dauran Jaglal Chaudhary ne Saran ke Garkha mein mass rebellion lead kiya. Unhone hazaron kisanon aur Daliton ke sath Garkha thana aur post office par attack karke aag laga di aur British rule ko samapt ghoshit kiya. British troops ne unhein arrest kiya aur summary court ne unhein 10 saal ki rigorous imprisonment di. 1937 aur 1946 ke Sri Krishna Sinha ki Congress cabinets mein unhein Minister banaya gaya. Minister rehte hue unhone Bihar mein pehli baar historic 'Total Prohibition' (sharab aur taadi bandi) policies enforce karwayin aur Dalit students ke liye free hostels khulwaye.

institutions_or_initiatives: Excise and Public Health Minister of Bihar (1937, 1946)
Founder of Harijan Residential Educational Centers
famous_works_or_edicts: A Plan to Reconstruct the Rural Economy of Bihar
Legislative Policies on Total Prohibition (1938)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Jaglal Chaudhary un unique leaders mein the jinhone azaadi ki ladai ke sath-sath social reconstruction ka practical model banaya. Unhone taadi bechne wale Pasi samaj ko palm-jaggery (taad ka gud) banane ke cottage industries mein engage karwaya. Unka banaya hua model modern social welfare policy ka precursor maana jata hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Saran ke Dalit kisanon dwara unki fearless governance ke karan unhein 'Saran ka Dalit Masiha' kaha gaya.
August 1942 mein Garkha thana par assault lead karna aur 10 saal ki jail term paana.
Chhapra mein unke naam par 'Jaglal Chaudhary College' operational hai; Patna mein unka official smarak sthit hai.
BPSC Prelims & Mains: '1942 ke andolan ke dauran Saran ke Garkha thana par hamle ka netritva kisne kiya tha? (Jaglal Chaudhary)' tatha '1937 ki Bihar cabinet mein Excise Minister kaun the?'

name: Ramdeni Singh (रामदेनी सिंह)
popular_title: Amar Shaheed of Minapur
qualifying_benchmark: Spearheaded Minapur Armed Rebellion (1930s/1942), Executed by Hanging at Bhagalpur Central Jail

birth_and_roots.background_context: Ramdeni Singh Muzaffarpur ke Minapur block ke ek sangharshsheel kisan parivar mein janme the. Minapur ka ilaka Tirhut division mein indigo planters aur British police excesses ke khilaf extreme resentment ka hub tha. Ramdeni Singh ne kishoravastha se hi violent revolutionary networks aur civil disobedience satyagrahon mein participate karna shuru kiya tha. Unka man-na tha ki British power ko tab tak Bihar se nahi bhagaya ja sakta jab tak unke administrative units par armed counter-attacks na kiye jayein.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Minapur Thana Siege, Assassination of Oppressive Police Officers, Armed Sabotage of British Posts
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Ramdeni Singh ne Minapur aur aas-paas ke ilakon mein militant peasant jatha organize kiya. Unhone colonial dak runners, police chaukis aur arms transport units par planned raids kiye. Ek bloody encounter ke dauran oppressive British police personnel ko neutralize kiya gaya aur government buildings jala di gayin. British administration ne massive manhunt chalakar unhein capture kiya aur unpar sedition aur murder ka trial chala kar capital punishment di. Bhagalpur Central Jail mein unhein phansi par latka kar execute kar diya gaya. Unhone aakhri saans tak 'Bharat Mata Ki Jai' ka naara lagaya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Proclamations calling upon Tirhut youth to liberate local police stations
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Ramdeni Singh ka balidan North Bihar ke militant agrarian resistance ka peak tha. Minapur thana incident ne colonial government ko yeh dikha diya ki Tirhut ke kisan sirf peaceful satyagraha tak simit nahi hain balki arms ke bal par thana capture karne ka dam rakhte hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Muzaffarpur ke krantikari itihaas mein unhein 'Minapur ka Amar Yoddha' kaha gaya.
Minapur thana revolt ke baad arrest hokar Bhagalpur Central Jail mein phansi par chadhna.
Minapur (Muzaffarpur) mein unka Shaheed Smarak sthit hai jahan har varsh shahadat diwas manaya jata hai.
BPSC History & Martyrs of Bihar: 'Muzaffarpur ke Minapur thana kand se jude kaun se krantikari Bhagalpur jail mein phansi par chadhaye gaye the? (Ramdeni Singh)'.

name: Kapil Deo Singh (कपिल देव सिंह)
popular_title: Guerrilla Commander of Munger (1942)
qualifying_benchmark: Foremost Guerrilla Commander of 1942 Quit India Movement in Munger, Destroyed British Communications and Regiments

birth_and_roots.background_context: Kapil Deo Singh Munger ke ek nidar aur physical combat mein master kisan parivar se aate the. Munger ka itihas 1930s ke Barahiya Tal Bakasht agitation aur armed resistance se juda hua tha. Jab August 1942 mein Mahatma Gandhi ne aavhan kiya, Kapil Deo Singh ne Munger ke forested terrain aur Diara ilake ko apna war theatre banaya. Unka command local youth aur peasant strikers par absolute tha.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Disruption of East Indian Railway Network, Attack on British Military Aerodromes, Munger Parallel Rule
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: August 1942 mein Kapil Deo Singh ne Munger mein militant underground squad organize kiya. Unhone East Indian Railway ki main line ko multiple places par completely uproot kar diya, jisse Calcutta se Northern India ka British military troop movement weeks tak cut-off ho gaya. Unhone telegraph poles cut kiye aur colonial treasuries par lightning raids ki. British Army ke Captain aur unke troops ko Diara ke ravines mein ambush kiya. British government ne unhein 'Most Wanted Rebel Commander' ghoshit karke unpar massive bounty lagayi, par local villagers ke support ke chalte police unhein trap nahi kar saki.

famous_works_or_edicts: Underground Sabotage Directives for Paralyzing Railway Transits (1942)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Kapil Deo Singh ke lead kiye gaye sabotage operations ke chalte British administration ne Munger aur Bhagalpur mein military aircrafts se machine-gun strafing tak conduct karwayi thi. Unke guerrilla strikes ne prove kiya ki Bihar ka peasant infrastructure British logistics ko immobilize karne ki power rakhta tha.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Munger ke rural circles mein unhein 'Munger ka Chhapamar Nayak' ke roop mein sammaan mila.
August 1942 mein Munger railway aur communication networks ko complete paralyze karna.
Munger ke 1942 movement archives mein unke underground operations ka official police record sanrakshit hai.
BPSC Modern History: '1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan mein Munger kshetra mein underground railway aur communication sabotage lead karne wale neta kaun the? (Kapil Deo Singh)'.

name: Mahendra Gope (महेंद्र गोप)
popular_title: Martyr Commander of Siyaram Dal
qualifying_benchmark: Key Armed Guerrilla Commander of Siyaram Dal, Executed by Hanging in Bhagalpur Central Jail in 1945

birth_and_roots.background_context: Mahendra Gope Bhagalpur ke Rampur gaon ke ek kisan Yadav parivar mein janme the. Unka vyaktitva nidar, athletic aur unshakeable courage se bhara tha. 1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan ke dauran ve Sardar Siyaram Singh ke 'Siyaram Dal' ke armed action squad ke key member bane. Ang kshetra ke kisanon aur pichhde vargon ko British police atyacharon se protect karne ke liye unhone hathiyar uthaye.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Siyaram Dal Armed Operations, Raid on British Police Posts, Execution at Bhagalpur Central Jail
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Mahendra Gope ne Siyaram Dal ke leading combatant ke roop mein multiple dangerous missions execute kiye. Unhone Sultanganj, Bihpur aur Sonbarsa police stations par raids mein direct firearms combat kiya aur British government records aur weapons capture kiye. Unhone colonial informers ko neutralize kiya jo British police ko secret meetings ki information dete the. Ek betrayed encounter ke baad British forces ne unhein arrest kiya. Bhagalpur court mein unpar murder aur rebellion ke multiple charges lagaye gaye. Aakhirkar 1945 mein unhein Bhagalpur Central Jail mein phansi par latka kar shaheed kar diya gaya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Courtroom statement refusing to beg clemency from British Crown
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Mahendra Gope ka balidan Siyaram Dal ke supreme sacrifice ka pinnacle hai. Unhone aakhri dum tak Siyaram Singh aur unke underground hideouts ka koi clue police ko nahi diya. Bhagalpur Central Jail mein unki hanging ne pure Ang kshetra mein azaadi ki aag ko azaadi aane tak ignite rakha.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Siyaram Dal ke armed martyrs mein sabse prominent hone ke karan unhein 'Bhagalpur ka Veer Balidani' kaha gaya.
1945 mein Siyaram Dal ke armed actions ke case mein Bhagalpur Central Jail mein execution.
Bhagalpur mein Mahendra Gope Smarak sthit hai jahan regular patriotic commemorations aayojit hote hain.
BPSC Prelims: '1942 ke Siyaram Dal ke kis pramukh krantikari yoddha ko Bhagalpur Central Jail mein phansi di gayi thi? (Mahendra Gope)'.

name: Umakant Prasad Sinha / Ramanand ji (उमाकांत प्रसाद सिन्हा)
popular_title: Patna Secretariat Martyr, Student of Ram Mohan Roy Seminary
qualifying_benchmark: Patna Secretariat Firing Martyr (11 August 1942), Shot Dead by British Police while Hoisting Tricolor

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Narendrapur village, Saran district (Goreakothi region), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Umakant Prasad Sinha ka janam Saran zile ke Narendrapur gaon ke ek aadarsh Kayastha parivar mein hua tha. Ve Patna mein Ram Mohan Roy Seminary School ke Class XI ke meritorious student the. Unke andar Swami Vivekananda ke vicharon aur swatantrata andolan ka prabal asar tha. 9 August 1942 ko jab Congress ke sabhi senior leaders arrest kar liye gaye, Umakant ne fellow students ke sath milkar Patna Secretariat par British Union Jack utarkar Indian Tricolour hoist karne ka historic pledge liya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Patna Secretariat March (11 August 1942), Tricolor Hoisting Action, Supreme Student Martyrdom
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 11 August 1942 ko dopahar lagbhag 2:00 baje hazaron vidyarthiyon ka juloos Patna Secretariat (Patna Sachivalaya) ki taraf badha. District Magistrate W.G. Archer ne Secretariat building ke main gate ko Gurkha military battalion se gher rakha tha. Juloos ke aage chalte hue Umakant Prasad Sinha national flag ko lehrate hue Secretariat gate ki tarah daude. W.G. Archer ke aadesh par Gurkha troops ne 13 se 14 rounds rifle direct firing open ki. Umakant bullet lagne se fatally wound hue aur unhone spot par hi national flag ko gale lagate hue shahadat paayi.

institutions_or_initiatives: Student Action Committee, Ram Mohan Roy Seminary (Patna, 1942)
famous_works_or_edicts: Student resolution of 10 August 1942 to hoist the National Flag on the Secretariat
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Umakant Prasad Sinha un amar 'Saat Shaheedon' (Seven Martyrs) mein shamil hain jinki 11 August 1942 ki shahadat ne Bihar ke 1942 movement ko violent mass uprising mein convert kar diya. Is incident ke baad Patna mein railway stations, courts aur post offices par janta ne kabja kar liya aur colonial authority kai hafton tak thapp ho gayi.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Patna Sachivalaya Goli-Kand ke 'Saat Shaheed' (Seven Martyrs) mein unka naam pratham line mein darj hai.
11 August 1942 ko Patna Secretariat par tiranga phahrane ke dauran police firing mein veergati prapt karna.
Patna Secretariat ke samne Deviprasad Roy Choudhury dwara banayi gayi vishal 'Shahid Smarak' (Martyrs' Memorial) statue unke samman mein sthit hai.
BPSC Prelims ka universal question: '11 August 1942 ko Patna Secretariat goli-kand mein shaheed hone wale vidyarthiyon mein Ram Mohan Roy Seminary ke chhatra kaun the? (Umakant Prasad Sinha)'.

name: Ramanand Singh (रामानंद सिंह)
popular_title: Patna Secretariat Child Martyr, Student of Ram Mohan Roy Seminary
qualifying_benchmark: Patna Secretariat Firing Martyr (11 August 1942), Class IX Student Shot Dead while Advancing with the Flag

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Sahadatnagar village, Dhanarua, Patna district, Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Ramanand Singh ka janam Patna ke Dhanarua block ke Sahadatnagar gaon ke ek kisan parivar mein hua tha. Ve Patna ke prasiddha Ram Mohan Roy Seminary School ke Class IX ke student the. Komal aayu hone ke bawajood unke andar rashtriya aatmasamman koot-koot kar bhara tha. Patna mein jab student agitations ufaan par the, Ramanand ne bina parivar ki parwah kiye 11 August ke Secretariat March mein frontline participant banne ka nischay kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Patna Secretariat Storming (11 August 1942), Sacrifice for National Flag, Student Vanguard Action
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 11 August 1942 ko jab students ka juloos Secretariat ke eastern gate par pahuncha, Ramanand Singh apne senior chhatron ke sath flag cordon banaye hue the. Police lathicharge aur mounted cavalry charges ke bawajood ve piche nahi hate. Jab Archer ke order par Gurkha rifles ne live fire open kiya, Ramanand Singh ko bullet direct body mein lagi aur ve wahi Secretariat premises ki mitti par gir pade. Unhone aakhri saans lete hue tirange ko zameen se utha kar dusre chhatra ke hath mein diya aur veergati ko prapt hue.

institutions_or_initiatives: Ram Mohan Roy Seminary Student Vanguard (1942)
famous_works_or_edicts: Student Pledge of 11 August 1942 for National Sovereignty
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Ramanand Singh ki balidan ne yeh pramanit kiya ki Patna ke schools azaadi ke fighters ki nurseries ban chuke the. Unki shahadat ne Patna ke aam nagarikon, railway coolies aur tonga-chalakon ko bhi azaadi ke andolan mein direct confrontation ke liye street par utar diya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Patna Sachivalaya ke 'Saat Amar Shaheedon' mein se ek hone ka gaurav prapt.
11 August 1942 ko Patna Secretariat ke samne police firing mein martyrdom.
Patna Shahid Smarak par unki murti sthit hai; Dhanarua (Patna) mein unke naam par memorial sthal sthit hai.
BPSC Prelims: 'Patna Sachivalaya goli-kand mein shaheed Ramanand Singh kis school ke chhatra the? (Ram Mohan Roy Seminary, Class IX)'.

name: Satish Prasad Jha (सतीश प्रसाद झा)
popular_title: Patna Secretariat Martyr, Student of Patna Collegiate School
qualifying_benchmark: Patna Secretariat Firing Martyr (11 August 1942), Patna Collegiate School Student Shot Dead at Secretariat Gate

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Kharhara village, Banka district (erstwhile Bhagalpur), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Satish Prasad Jha ka janam Banka ke Kharhara gaon ke ek vidwan kisan parivar mein hua tha. Ve Patna ke premier aur aitihasik school 'Patna Collegiate School' ke Class X ke meritorious student the. Unka man shuru se hi swadeshi vicharon aur Rashtrakavi Dinkar ki kavitayein padhne mein lagta tha. August 1942 ke aavhan ke baad Patna Collegiate ke vidyarthiyon ne Secretariat par tiranga phahrane ka lead lene ka sankalp liya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Patna Secretariat Flag March (11 August 1942), Student Mobilization, Direct Martyrdom under Rifle Salvo
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 11 August 1942 ko Satish Prasad Jha ne Patna Collegiate School ke vidyarthiyon ke dal ko lead kiya aur Secretariat campus ke bheetar pravesh karne ki koshish ki. Jab British District Magistrate ne firing ka sign diya, Satish Prasad Jha ne flag bearers ko cover dene ke liye aage badhe. British troops ki rifle bullet unke shareer ko bhed gayi aur ve wahi Secretariat building ke samne veer-gati ko prapt hue. Unki mrityu ne Banka aur Bhagalpur ke unke home region mein bhi aakrosh ki aag bhadkayi.

famous_works_or_edicts: Student resolution of Patna Collegiate School pledging martyrdom for the tricolor
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Satish Prasad Jha un amar saat chhatron mein the jinhone colonial bureaucracy ke sanctum-sanctorum (Secretariat) ko challenge kiya. Unke balidan ne yeh establish kiya ki Ang Pradesh aur Mithila dono ke vidyarthi Patna ke central struggle mein barabar ke bhagidar the.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: 11 August 1942 ke Patna Secretariat ke 'Saat Shaheedon' mein se ek.
11 August 1942 ko Patna Secretariat par tricolor unfurl karte waqt police firing mein shaheed hona.
Patna Secretariat Shahid Smarak par unka aadamkad prateek sthit hai; Banka mein unke gaon Kharhara mein memorial gate sthit hai.
BPSC Prelims: 'Patna Sachivalaya firing (11 August 1942) mein shaheed Satish Prasad Jha kis school ke student the? (Patna Collegiate School, Class X)'.

name: Jagpati Kumar (जगति कुमार)
popular_title: Patna Secretariat Martyr, Hero of BN College
qualifying_benchmark: Patna Secretariat Firing Martyr (11 August 1942), B.N. College Student Shot Dead while Breaching Secretariat Perimeter

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Kharathi village, Obra, Aurangabad district (erstwhile Gaya), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Jagpati Kumar ka janam Aurangabad ke Obra block ke Kharathi gaon ke ek kisan parivar mein hua tha. Ve Bihar National College (B.N. College, Patna) ke second-year student the. B.N. College us samay freedom fighters aur student political debates ka hub mana jata tha. Jagpati Kumar college ke student politics aur anti-imperialist strikes mein actively participate karte the. 11 August 1942 ke Secretariat march mein unhone college contingent ko lead kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Patna Secretariat Direct Action, B.N. College Student Leadership, Supreme Martyrdom under Gunfire
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 11 August 1942 ko dopahar jab thousands of students Secretariat compound mein enter hone lage, Jagpati Kumar sabse frontline barricades ko todne wale yuvakon mein the. Jab Gurkha soldiers ne District Magistrate Archer ke order par firing start ki, Jagpati Kumar ne chest par bullet receive ki. Triple bullets lagne ke bawajood ve zameen par gir kar bhi 'Inquilab Zindabad' aur 'Bharat Mata Ki Jai' chillaate rahe jab tak unki saans chali. Hospital le jate waqt unhone dam tod diya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Student slogans challenging the legitimacy of British rule over provincial secretariats
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Jagpati Kumar ka balidan college-level youth mobilization ka supreme example tha. Unke balidan ke baad B.N. College aur Patna College ke students ne underground networks bana kar Azad Dasta aur railway sabotage operations ko reinforce kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Patna Sachivalaya ke 'Saat Shaheedon' mein B.N. College ke amar balidani ke roop mein darj.
11 August 1942 ko Patna Secretariat gate par police firing mein bullet lagne se veergati.
Patna Shahid Smarak par unki murti sanrakshit hai; B.N. College campus mein unka smarak board sthit hai.
BPSC Prelims: 'Patna Sachivalaya goli-kand mein shaheed hone wale B.N. College ke chhatra kaun the? (Jagpati Kumar, Aurangabad)'.

name: Devipada Choudhary (देवीपद चौधरी)
popular_title: Patna Secretariat Martyr, Student of Miller High School
qualifying_benchmark: Patna Secretariat Firing Martyr (11 August 1942), Miller High English School Student Martyred for the Flag

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Silhat village, Jamalpur, Munger district, Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Devipada Choudhary ka janam Munger ke Jamalpur ke paas Silhat gaon ke ek sanskritik parivar mein hua tha. Padhai ke liye ve Patna aaye jahan Miller High English School (modern-day Miller Senior Secondary School) ke Class IX ke student the. Jamalpur railway workshop ke strike culture aur Munger ke kisan struggles ne unke andar rashtriya chetna paida ki thi. Jab Patna mein August Kranti ka ailan hua, Devipada ne Miller School ke chhatron ko flag march mein shamil kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Patna Secretariat Storming (11 August 1942), High School Student Mobilization, Martyrdom under Rifle Volley
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 11 August 1942 ko Devipada Choudhary Miller High School ke chhatron ke sath Secretariat march mein shamil hue. Jab police ne lathicharge se bheed ko roknay ki koshish ki, Devipada ne building ke boundary railings ko climb karne ka prayas kiya taaki flag ko unchi jagah par bandha ja sake. Is dauran British police ne rifle fire open kar diya aur ek bullet seedhe Devipada ko lagi. Ve wahi Secretariat ke main lawn par gir pade aur unhone ran-kshetra mein apna sarvochha balidan diya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Student oath to dislodge the Union Jack from Patna Secretariat
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Devipada Choudhary ki shahadat ne yeh dikhaya ki school ke high-class English schools ke students bhi British Raj ke khilaf kisi bhi tarah ka samjhauta nahi chahte the. Unka balidan Patna ke Seven Martyrs ka ek unforgetable chapter bana.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: 11 August 1942 ke Patna Secretariat firing ke 'Saat Amar Shaheedon' mein se ek.
11 August 1942 ko Patna Secretariat building ke samne rifle fire mein shahadat.
Patna Secretariat ke samne Shahid Smarak par unki murti sthit hai; Miller High School mein unka smriti stambha sthit hai.
BPSC Prelims: 'Patna Sachivalaya goli-kand mein shaheed Devipada Choudhary kis school ke chhatra the? (Miller High School, Class IX)'.

name: Rajendra Singh (राजेन्द्र सिंह)
popular_title: Patna Secretariat Martyr, Student of Patna High School
qualifying_benchmark: Patna Secretariat Firing Martyr (11 August 1942), Matriculation Student of Patna High School Shot Dead

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Banwarichak village, Naya Gaon, Saran district, Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Rajendra Singh ka janam Saran zile ke Naya Gaon ke Banwarichak gaon ke ek kisan parivar mein hua tha. Ve Patna High School (Gardanibagh) ke Matriculation (Class X) ke bright student the. Saran ki krantikari mitti aur Patna ke student environment ne unke andar fearless patriotism inject kiya tha. Unhone apne classmates ke sath decide kiya ki 11 August ko Secretariat ke shikhar par tiranga phahra kar British hukumat ke ghamand ko todna hai.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Patna Secretariat Assault (11 August 1942), Matric Student Leadership, Supreme Martyrdom under Gurkha Firing
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 11 August 1942 ko Rajendra Singh Patna High School contingent ke agle hisse mein the. Jab DM Archer ne firing order issue kiya aur Gurkha soldiers ne goliyan chalayi, Rajendra Singh ne tirange ko dono haathon se upar uthaye rakha aur gate ki taraf sprint kiya. Rifle bullet lagne se ve fatally injured hue aur unka khoon tirange par bikhar gaya. Spot par hi unhone veergati paayi. Unki shahadat ne Gardanibagh aur Patna ke dehati suburbs mein immediate public rebellion trigger kiya.

institutions_or_initiatives: Patna High School Student Resistance Squad (1942)
famous_works_or_edicts: Flag protection pledge taken by Patna High School matric students
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Rajendra Singh ki shahadat ne school-going generation ke supreme courage ko immortalize kiya. Unke balidan ke baad Bihar ke har school aur college par chhatron ne British flags jala kar national tricolour unfurl karne ki wave shuru ki.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Patna Sachivalaya ke 'Saat Shaheedon' mein Patna High School ke amar yoddha ke roop mein darj.
11 August 1942 ko Patna Secretariat par firing ke dauran veer-gati prapt karna.
Patna Shahid Smarak statue ensemble mein unki murti sthit hai; Patna High School campus mein unki smriti board sanrakshit hai.
BPSC Prelims: 'Patna Secretariat firing (11 August 1942) mein shaheed Rajendra Singh kis school ke student the? (Patna High School, Class X)'.

name: Ramgovind Singh (रामगोविंद सिंह)
popular_title: Patna Secretariat Martyr, Student of Punpun High School
qualifying_benchmark: Patna Secretariat Firing Martyr (11 August 1942), Punpun High School Student Martyred for the National Flag

birth_and_roots.background_context: Ramgovind Singh ka janam Patna ke Dashratha gaon ke ek kisan parivar mein hua tha. Ve Punpun High School ke Class IX ke student the. Rural Patna ke kisanon ke shoshan aur Mahatma Gandhi ke 'Karo ya Maro' sandesh ne unhein school se nikaalkar direct struggle mein utara. 11 August ko ve apne dehati school ke chhatron ke sath chalkar Patna Secretariat march mein shamil hue.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Patna Secretariat Storming (11 August 1942), Rural-Urban Student Synthesis, Martyrdom under Rifle Salvo
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 11 August 1942 ko jab thousands of youth Secretariat ke main structure ko surround kar rahe the, Ramgovind Singh flag bearer squad ke immediate protection line mein the. Police firing shuru hote hi jab pehli volley chali, Ramgovind Singh ne retreating students ko rukne aur flag aage le jane ke liye aavhan kiya. Agli hi bullet unke sharir ko bhed gayi aur ve spot par hi shaheed ho gaye. Unki shahadat ne Punpun aur Fatuha ke railway belts par complete mass rebellion unleash kar diya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Student appeals to rural youth along Punpun river to march to Patna Secretariat
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Ramgovind Singh un Saat Shaheedon mein the jinhone yeh dikha diya ki 1942 ka aakrosh sirf urban elite schools tak nahi balki semi-rural Punpun jaise mofussil towns tak fail chuka tha. Unke balidan ne Bihar ke peasants aur students ko ek platform par lakar khada kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: 11 August 1942 Patna Secretariat firing ke 'Saat Shaheedon' mein se ek.
11 August 1942 ko Patna Secretariat gate ke samne police firing mein martyrdom.
Patna Secretariat ke samne Shahid Smarak par unki murti sthit hai; Punpun mein unke samman mein local memorials sthit hain.
BPSC Prelims: 'Patna Sachivalaya goli-kand mein shaheed Ramgovind Singh kis school ke student the? (Punpun High School, Class IX)'.

name: Shanti Devi (शांति देवी)
popular_title: Agni-Kanya of Chhapra, Underground Radio & Courier Leader
qualifying_benchmark: Spearheaded 1942 Underground Clandestine Courier and Communication Network, Led Civil Disobedience Processions in Saran

birth_and_roots.background_context: Shanti Devi Saran ke ek committed nationalist parivar se thin. Unka parivar shuruat se Gandhi ji ke constructive program aur Congress volunteer movement se juda hua tha. Saran zila jo 1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan mein 'Krantikari Zila' ghoshit ho chuka tha, wahan mahilaon ko organize karne aur police surveillance ke beech underground leaders ke communications carry karne ki kadi zimmedari Shanti Devi ne uthayi.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Underground Courier Network 1942, Clandestine Bulletin Distribution, Mobilization of Rural Women in Saran
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: August 1942 mein jab top Congress leaders arrest ho gaye aur press censorship lag gayi, Shanti Devi ne Suniti Devi aur anya mahilaon ke sath milkar underground courier network manage kiya. Unhone cycle aur paidal chal kar British police checkpoints ko bypass kiya aur Azad Dasta ke revolutionary pamphlets, illegal bulletins aur directives Saran, Patna aur Champaran ke secret cells tak deliver karwayin. Unhone Chhapra town mein government kachehris ke gherao ke liye women's processions lead kiye. British police ne unpar sedition warrants issue kiye aur unhein arrest karke jail mein qaid rakha.

famous_works_or_edicts: Clandestine Bulletins circulated during 1942 movement in Saran
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Shanti Devi ka contribution resistance warfare ki intelligence aur communication backbone maintain karne mein tha. Agar clandestine couriers na hote toh Azad Dasta aur local field units ke beech coordination collapse ho jata. Unhone dikhaya ki women fighters surveillance systems ko effortlessly penetrate kar sakti thin.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Saran ke underground resistance circles mein unhein 'Saran ki Nidar Courier Senani' kaha gaya.
1942 ke doran intense British intelligence surveillance ke beech underground communication network maintain karna.
Saran district gazetteer aur Bihar State Archives mein unke underground activities ke dossiers sanrakshit hain.
BPSC History: '1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan ke dauran Saran/Chhapra mein underground communication aur mahila julooson ko lead karne wali pramukh mahila kaun thin? (Shanti Devi)'.
